item.title: Former White House Chief of Staff: "South Korean Government Treats U.S. Companies Like Piggy Banks… Alliance Unviable" (트럼프 前비서실장 “한국 정부, 美기업을 저금통 취급… 동맹 지속 안 돼”)
item.description:
Former White House Chief of Staff: "South Korean Government Treats U.S. Companies Like Piggy Banks… Alliance Unviable" (트럼프 前비서실장 “한국 정부, 美기업을 저금통 취급… 동맹 지속 안 돼”)

Mark Meadows, who served as White House chief of staff during the first Trump administration, argued on the 22nd regarding the Coupang incident—which has been a stumbling block in South Korea-U.S. bilateral relations for over six months—that "the South Korean government should not treat U.S. tech companies like bottomless piggy banks." He claimed that if the double standard of granting "leniency" to South Korean companies in the U.S. while imposing penalties on U.S. companies in South Korea continues, "no alliance can endure." Meadows, a former four-term congressman and member of the hardline Freedom Caucus, is considered a figure who spearheaded the radicalization of the Republican Party in the mid-2010s. Though now out of frontline politics, his remarks represent the perspective of the MAGA (Make America Great Again) camp on the Coupang situation. (트럼프 1기 정부 출신으로 백악관 비서실장을 지낸 마크 메도우스는 22일 반년 넘게 한미 양자(兩者) 관계의 장애물로 작용하고 있는 쿠팡 사태 관련 “한국 정부가 미 테크 기업들을 끝없는 저금통(bottomless piggy bank)처럼 취급해서는 안 된다”며 미국 내 한국 기업에는 ‘관용’을 베풀고 한국 내 미 기업에 대해선 처벌을 가하는 ‘이중 잣대’가 지속되면 “어떤 동맹도 지속될 수 없다”고 주장했다. 메도우스는 4선(選) 하원의원 출신으로 강성 모임인 ‘프리덤 코커스’ 소속으로 활동하며 2010년대 중반 공화당의 급진화를 주도했다는 평가를 받는 인물이다. 현재는 일선에서 물러났지만, 그의 주장은 쿠팡 사태를 보는 매가(MAGA·미국을 다시 위대하게) 진영의 시각을 대변하고 있다.)

In an op-ed published on the conservative online media outlet Daily Caller, Meadows stated, "The South Korea-U.S. alliance is indispensable, but it is quietly eroding the foundation of mutual trust behind the scenes." He noted that following a raid by immigration authorities on a Hyundai Motor and LG Energy Solution plant in Georgia last year, "Washington accepted Seoul's request for leniency to maintain a cooperative partnership." "The outraged South Korean government condemned the enforcement as a 'betrayal,' and the U.S., as a good-faith ally, accepted the concession," he wrote. In contrast, he claimed that after a personal information leak incident at Coupang, "despite U.S. authorities expressing concerns over an imbalanced and politicized response, Seoul (South Korea's government) intensified its enforcement." (메도우스는 이날 보수 성향 온라인 매체 ‘데일리 콜러’에 기고한 글에서 “한미 동맹은 없어서 안 될 관계지만 뒤편에서 상호 신뢰 기반을 조용히 훼손하고 있다”며 이같이 주장했다. 그는 지난해 조지아주(州)의 현대차·LG에너지솔루션 공장에 대한 이민 당국의 급습 이후 “워싱턴이 협력적 파트너십을 유지하기 위해 한국 정부의 관용 요청을 수용했다” “격분한 한국 정부는 단속을 ‘배신’이라 규탄했고, 미국은 선의의 동맹으로 양보를 받아들였다”고 했다. 반면 쿠팡에서 개인 정보 유출 사고가 불거지고 난 뒤 “미 당국이 불균형적이고 정치화된 대응에 우려를 표명했음에도 불구하고 서울(한국) 정부가 단속을 강화했다”고 주장했다.)

Regarding the Personal Information Protection Commission (PIPC) imposing a record fine of about 625 billion won, Meadows asserted, "That was just the beginning. The Fair Trade Commission (KFTC) and ten other agencies launched over 40 investigations, with the South Korean government waging an all-out war against Coupang." An interim report released by the U.S. House Judiciary Committee shows that during Coupang's recall of laptops linked to a personal information leak in China, close communication occurred between the company and the South Korean government. This contradicts the government's claim of "no directives or coercion." Meadows said, "Shortly after Coupang engaged in a risky joint operation with the South Korean government, regulatory authorities pressured for criminal charges against the CEO. The South Korean government later denied involvement in the operation, which is not how an ally should behave." (메도우스는 개인정보보호위원회(PIPC)가 역대 최고 수준인 약 6250억원의 과징금을 부과한 것 관련 “단지 시작에 불과했고 공정위(KFTC) 등 11개 기관이 40건 이상의 조사를 개시해 한국 정부가 쿠팡을 상대로 총력전을 펼쳤다”고 주장했다. 미 하원 법사위원회가 발표한 중간 보고서를 보면 쿠팡 측이 중국에서 개인 정보 유출이 문제가 된 노트북을 회수하는 과정에서 우리 정부와 긴밀한 소통이 이뤄진 것으로 나타났다. 이는 “어떤 지시, 강요도 없었다”는 정부 설명과는 배치되는 대목이다. 메도우스는 “쿠팡이 한국 정부와 위험한 합동 작전을 벌인 직후 규제 당국이 최고경영자(CEO)에 대한 형사 고발을 압박했다”며 “한국 정부는 나중에 작전에 관여한 사실도 부인했는데, 이는 동맹국으로서의 태도가 아니다”라고 했다.)

Meadows argued, "If the South Korean government expects Washington to open its markets to South Korean conglomerates, it should not treat U.S. tech companies like piggy banks. Friendship is based on reciprocity." He added, "As long as there is a double standard of granting leniency to South Korean companies in the U.S. while imposing imbalanced penalties on U.S. companies in South Korea, no alliance can endure." Earlier, not only the House but also Vice President J.D. Vance, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, and members of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) had repeatedly called on South Korea to resolve the Coupang incident. There is a perception in U.S. political circles that while signals for reconciliation and negotiations have been conveyed multiple times, the South Korean government has failed to provide proper feedback. A senior official familiar with the House Judiciary Committee's investigation recently told this newspaper, "The South Korean government's response fails to adequately address the facts we have confirmed. If they dismiss the report as 'meritless,' the situation will only worsen." (메도우스는 “한국 정부가 워싱턴(미국)이 한국 대기업들에 시장을 개방해주기를 기대한다면 미 테크 기업을 저금통처럼 취급해서는 안 된다”며 “우정은 상호성을 전제로 하는 것”이라고 했다. 그는 “미국 내에서는 한국 기업에 관용을 베풀고, 한국 내에서는 미국 기업에 대한 불균형적인 처벌을 가하는 이중 잣대를 적용하는 한 어떤 동맹도 지속될 수 없다”고 했다. 앞서 하원뿐만 아니라 J D 밴스 부통령, 마코 루비오 국무장관, 공화당 연구위원회(RSC) 소속 의원 등이 잇따라 한국에 쿠팡 사태 해결을 요구해 왔다. 미 조야(朝野)에서는 이런 화해 및 담판 의지가 여러 차례 전달됐지만 우리 정부가 제대로 된 피드백을 주지 않고 있다고 인식하고 있다. 하원 법사위 조사 사정에 밝은 한 고위 인사는 최근 본지에 “한국 정부 대응은 우리가 확인한 사실을 제대로 다루지 못하고 있다”며 “보고서를 ‘쓸모없는(meritless)’ 것으로 일축하면 상황은 더 악화할 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae: "JMS's Jeong Myeong-seok is my uncle?... Legal action" (정청래 “JMS 정명석씨가 저의 작은 아버지?...법적 조치”)
item.description:
Jeong Cheong-rae: "JMS's Jeong Myeong-seok is my uncle?... Legal action" (정청래 “JMS 정명석씨가 저의 작은 아버지?...법적 조치”)

As the Democratic Party of Korea is embroiled in controversy over alleged 'Shincheonji election interference' ahead of the August 17 party convention, Jeong Cheong-rae, a candidate for party leader, stated that "(the allegations of Shincheonji involvement) are 100% fake news." (더불어민주당이 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 ‘신천지 선거 개입설’ 등으로 시끄러운 가운데, 정청래 더불어민주당 당대표 후보가 “(신천지 연루 의혹 등은) 100% 가짜 뉴스”라고 했다.)

In a YouTube channel interview on the night of the 22nd, former leader Jeong firmly addressed the recent Shincheonji controversy, saying, "I have no connection whatsoever to Shincheonji. It's 100% fake news." He continued, "Some YouTubers are attacking me for attending the naming ceremony of the 'Peace Nobel Road' at the Gyeongui Line Forest Park in Donggyo-dong, my district (in June 2019). At that time, the current Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance, as well as the head of Mapo District Office and the police chief, also attended and gave congratulatory speeches, but they're trying to tie that together." (정 전 대표는 22일 밤 유튜브 채널 인터뷰에서 최근 불거진 신천지 논란에 대해 “신천지와 아무런 관련이 없다. 100% 가짜 뉴스다”고 단언했다.이어 “제 지역구인 동교동 경의선 숲길 공원에서 (2019년 6월) ‘평화의 노벨길’ 명명식 행사에 참석한 것을 가지고 일부 유튜버가 공격하고 있다”며 “그때 지금 경제부총리인 구윤철 기재부 장관, 마포구청장, 경찰서장도 참석해 축사했는데 그걸 엮으려 한다”고 했다.)

He said, "Looking at the comments now, party members are outraged, asking, 'So if I support Rep. Jeong Cheong-rae, does that make me a Shincheonji follower?' They're demanding, 'Produce the evidence quickly.'" (그는 “지금 댓글을 보니 ‘정청래 의원 지지하는 내가 그럼 신천지 신도란 말이냐’며 당원들이 분노한다”며 “빨리 근거를 대라”고 했다.)

Earlier, on the 21st, former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, a rival in the party leadership race, claimed, "Shincheonji is interfering in the party convention," and said, "I will release the evidence soon." While he did not specify who specifically the Shincheonji forces are supporting, pro-government YouTubers are spreading rumors about 'former leader Jeong Cheong-rae's involvement.' (앞서 당권 경쟁자인 김민석 전 국무총리는 지난 21일 “신천지가 전당대회에 개입하고 있다”며 “조만간 증거를 공개하겠다”고 했었다. 그는 신천지 세력이 구체적으로 누구를 지원하고 있는지는 언급하지 않았지만 친여 유튜버들은 ‘정청래 전 대표의 연루설’을 퍼뜨리고 있는 상황이다.)

Former leader Jeong stated, "Raising suspicions that 'Shincheonji is trying to exert influence' over the Democratic Party convention is an extremely dangerous claim that could drive the party into being labeled an unconstitutional party. This is more serious than illegal electioneering, so strong punishment and legal action are necessary." (정 전 대표는 “민주당 전당 대회에 ‘신천지가 영향력을 행사하려고 한다’며 개입 의혹을 제기하는 건 당이 위헌정당으로 내몰릴 수 있는 위험천만한 주장”이라며 “이는 해당 행위보다도 더 심각한 사항이기에 강력한 응징과 법적 조치가 필요하다”고 했다.)

He added, "If I am involved (with Shincheonji), don't just suspect me—report me to the police and provide evidence. If you can't, you should apologize." (그러면서 “제가 (신천지에) 연루돼 있다면 의심만 말고 저를 경찰에 고발하고 근거를 대라”며 “그렇지 못하다면 사과해야 할 것이다”고 했다.)

Former leader Jeong also mentioned that false claims are being spread that Jeong Myeong-seok, the head of the Christian Gospel Mission (commonly known as JMS), who is serving a prison sentence for sexually assaulting a female follower, is 'Jeong Cheong-rae's uncle.' He said, "A YouTuber claimed that JMS's Jeong Myeong-seok is my uncle, so I plan to take legal action. I have never met Jeong Myeong-seok, never exchanged a single phone call with him, and don't even know where he lives." Former leader Jeong explained the naming tradition in his family, saying, "My father's brothers all have the character 'Hae' in their names: my uncle is 'Hae0', and my youngest uncle is 'Hae0'," adding, "There are no names with 'Myeong' or 'Seok' in our family." (정 전 대표는 여신도 성폭행 혐의로 복역 중인 기독교복음선교회(통칭 JMS)의 정명석 총재가 ‘정청래 작은아버지’라는 말까지 유포되고 있다고도 했다. 그는 “어느 유튜버가 JMS 정명석 씨가 저의 작은 아버지라고 해 법적 조치를 할 예정이다”며 “정명석 씨와 일면식도, 전화 한 통 한 적 없고 어디 사는지도 모른다”고 했다. 정 전 대표는 “저희 아버지 형제들은 ‘해’자 돌림으로 작은아버지는 ‘해0’, 막내 삼촌은 ‘해0’이다”며 가문의 돌림자까지 설명한 뒤 “명자, 석자 돌림은 없다”고도 했다.)

item.title: Korean-American ‘Powerful’ Group Angry at Ambassador to US… “Avoiding the Spotlight Out of Caution, Causing Disappointment and Dismay” (주미 대사에 뿔난 ‘실세’ 한인 단체… “눈치 보며 자리 피해, 실망과 경악”)
item.description:
Korean-American ‘Powerful’ Group Angry at Ambassador to US… “Avoiding the Spotlight Out of Caution, Causing Disappointment and Dismay” (주미 대사에 뿔난 ‘실세’ 한인 단체… “눈치 보며 자리 피해, 실망과 경악”)

Choi Kwang-chul, head of the pro-progressive Korean-American organization Korean American Participation and Action Committee (KAPAC), has taken issue with Ambassador to the US Kang Kyung-wha’s absence from an event, claiming, “The ambassador, who should be at the forefront of peace diplomacy, avoided the spotlight out of caution, leaving attendees unable to hide their disappointment and dismay,” and asking, “What are the security office, the foreign ministry, and the embassy to the US of the Lee Jae-myung administration, which was born with the support of progressive and peace forces, doing?” Choi, a Korean-American businessman, is known to be a junior at Kyung Hee University Law School to former President Moon Jae-in and served as a diplomatic and security special advisor for President Lee Jae-myung’s election campaign, with ties dating back to Lee’s tenure as mayor of Seongnam. He has been active in pushing for the so-called “Korean Peninsula Peace Act” (H.R. 1841), which calls for a declaration to end the Korean War, to pass through the US Congress. <<> The incident began with the “2026 Korean Peninsula Peace Conference” held by KAPAC in Washington DC from the 24th to the 26th of last month. The event was flooded with congratulatory messages from key figures in the ruling camp, including President Lee Jae-myung, former President Moon Jae-in, and National Assembly Speaker Cho Jung-sik. The organizers initially notified the media that Ambassador Kang would also attend, but on the day of the event, Rep. Song Young-gil of the Democratic Party, who led a delegation from South Korea to the US, took the stage to read President Lee’s congratulatory remarks on his behalf. Choi is known to be close to Rep. Song Young-gil, and reportedly attended a meeting when Song visited the US in April to meet with then-Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard. On stage, Song said, “Next year, we’ll ensure that the ministers of foreign affairs and unification can also attend.” Choi recently noted on his social media, “The ambassador, who should have graced the event, ultimately didn’t show up, leading to the regrettable scene of former leader Song Young-gil reading the president’s congratulatory remarks.” <<> The event was attended by about 10 Democratic House members, including Brad Sherman, who proposed the declaration of war end bill, and Korean-American Dave Min. Sherman is a prominent anti-Trump figure in the Democratic Party, who proposed an impeachment motion against Trump during his first term. KAPAC recently announced that 52 lawmakers have signed onto the bill, “securing support from 12% of the 435 members of the US House of Representatives,” but since the majority are Democratic lawmakers and mainstream Republican lawmakers oppose it, the bill’s chances of passing this session are slim. It was also automatically discarded during the 117th and 118th Congresses. Choi criticized the government for participating as a co-sponsor of the UN resolution on North Korean human rights and mentioning North Korean denuclearization in a joint statement with the European Union, claiming, “Outwardly, they say they will become the ‘pacemaker for Trump, the peacemaker,’ but their actual actions are mired in the contradiction of following the same hardline confrontation structure of the previous Yoon Suk Yeol administration.” <<> Last month, Choi also stated on his social media, “The most disappointing aspect of the Lee Jae-myung administration is its absolute lack of understanding of new public diplomacy, which aims to achieve peace on the Korean Peninsula by expanding the actors of diplomacy,” adding, “The traditional subservient diplomacy centered on the security office, which is staffed by former foreign ministry officials, continues. When necessary, decisive action such as reviewing the transfer and decentralization of Korean Peninsula peace diplomacy from the foreign ministry to the unification ministry is needed.” He also argued, “A sweeping personnel overhaul in the diplomatic and security sectors is urgent.” Ambassador Kang unusually returned to South Korea temporarily from the 15th to the 19th of last month under the direction of Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul and stayed in the country. During her visit to South Korea, she met with relevant ministries to discuss major pending issues between Korea and the US, leading to various interpretations about the background behind this. (미국의 친여(親與) 성향 한인 단체인 미주민주참여포럼(KAPAC)의 최광철 대표가 행사에 강경화 주미대사가 참석하지 않은 것을 문제 삼으며 “평화 외교의 최전선에 서야 할 주미대사가 눈치를 보며 자리를 피한 사태에 참석자들이 실망과 경악을 금치 못했다” “진보·평화 세력의 지지로 탄생한 이재명 정부의 안보실, 외교부, 주미대사관은 무얼 하고 있는가”라고 주장했다. 재미(在美) 사업가인 최 대표는 문재인 전 대통령의 경희대 법대 후배이자 이재명 대통령의 대선 캠프 외교·안보 특보 출신으로 성남시장 시절부터 인연을 맺은 것으로 알려져 있다. 한반도 종전 선언 등을 골자로 하는 이른바 ‘한반도 평화 법안(H.R. 1841)’의 미 의회 통과를 위한 활동을 해왔다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Unlimited Loans Using Ultra-Expensive Homes as Collateral for Business Funds Is a Loophole" (李대통령 “초고가 주택 담보로 사업자금 무제한 대출은 꼼수”)
item.description:
President Lee: "Unlimited Loans Using Ultra-Expensive Homes as Collateral for Business Funds Is a Loophole" (李대통령 “초고가 주택 담보로 사업자금 무제한 대출은 꼼수”)

At the 'National Debate on Housing Policy' held on the 23rd, President Lee Jae-myung pointed out the current system where ultra-expensive homes are used as unlimited collateral for loans for other purposes, such as business funds, and instructed policy authorities to promptly reconsider measures to limit the recognition of collateral value and loan limits for ultra-expensive homes. While loans for purchasing ultra-expensive homes are strictly restricted, once acquired, applying for mortgage loans under the guise of 'company operating funds' or 'business funds' allows borrowing large sums without limits, functioning as a channel for circumventing regulations. (이재명 대통령이 23일 열린 ‘부동산 정책 국민 대토론회’에서 초고가 주택이 사업자금 등 타 용도 대출의 무제한 담보로 활용되는 현행 제도를 지적하며 초고가 주택의 담보 가치 인정 및 대출 한도를 제한하는 방안을 정책당국이 조속히 재검토하라고 지시했다. 초고가 주택을 살 때는 주택구입자금 대출이 엄격히 제한되지만, 일단 취득한 뒤 ‘회사 운영자금’이나 ‘사업 자금’ 명목으로 담보대출을 신청하면 한도 없이 거액을 조달할 수 있어 편법 우회 대출 통로로 기능하고 있다.)

◇"Blocking Home Purchases, but Unlimited Loans for Business Funds?" (◇“주택 취득은 막아놓고 사업자금은 무제한 대출?”)

During the debate, President Lee asked research fellow Kim Young-do from the Korea Institute of Finance, who participated as an expert panelist, "Currently, when purchasing a high-priced home, housing purchase loans are almost impossible, right?" He then inquired, "If so, after acquiring real estate without loans, if someone needs 5 billion or 10 billion won for general purposes or company operating funds rather than home purchase funds, can they secure that by providing their ultra-expensive home as collateral without limit?" (토론 과정에서 이 대통령은 전문가 패널로 참석한 김영도 금융연구원 연구위원에게 “지금은 고가 주택을 매입할 때 주택 구입 대출이 거의 안 되지 않느냐”고 물은 뒤, “그렇다면 담보 없이 부동산을 취득한 뒤 주택 구입 자금이 아닌 일반 용도나 회사 운영 자금으로 50억, 100억원이 필요할 때 개인이 가진 초고가 주택을 담보로 제공하면 다 받아주는 것이냐”고 질의했다.)

When the answer came, "Yes, even with an apartment as collateral, business funds can be borrowed without a limit on scale," President Lee responded, "While loans for home purchase funds are not allowed, if they are recognized as collateral for other-purpose loans, one can easily raise funds through loopholes, acquire it, and then use it as collateral for different-name loans to bypass lending regulations." He added, "The system of recognizing the collateral value of high-priced homes unlimitedly must be completely reconsidered." (이에 “맞다. 아파트를 담보로 제공해도 사업자금은 규모 제한 없이 대출을 받을 수 있다”는 답변이 나오자, 이 대통령은 “주택 취득 자금을 대출해 주지는 않지만, 다른 용도의 자금 대출 담보로 인정해 주면 편법으로 얼마든지 자금을 조달해 취득한 뒤 다른 명목 대출의 담보로 내서 대출 규제를 우회할 수 있다”며 “무제한으로 고가 주택의 담보 가치를 인정해 주는 제도는 전면 재고해 봐야 한다”고 했다.)

◇Orders to the Presidential Office and Financial Authorities to Restrict Circumvention Loans (◇靑·금융 당국에 우회 대출 제한 조치 지시)

President Lee said, "Looking at the current objective situation, it seems that pre- and post-loan inspections to ensure funds are used for their intended purposes are not being conducted properly," and instructed, "It often surfaces only when problems arise. Policy authorities should consider practical measures, such as limiting unlimited collateral recognition." In response, Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won stated, "We have a post-inspection system in place to track and recover loans misused for other purposes or impose penalties," and answered, "As per the President's instructions, we will examine this more thoroughly and explore various measures to prevent circumvention loans." (이 대통령은 “현재 객관적인 상황을 보면 과연 대출 용도대로 쓰는지 사전·사후 검문검색을 잘 안 하는 것 같다”며 “특별히 문제가 됐을 때나 나중에 적발하는 형태인데, 무제한 담보 인정을 제한하는 등 정책 당국이 실질적인 대책을 생각해야 한다”고 지시했다. 이에 회의에 참석한 이억원 금융위원장은 “대출금을 용도 외로 유용한 경우 추적해서 회수하거나 페널티를 주는 사후 점검 체계를 갖추고 있다”며 “대통령 지시대로 더 철저히 따져보고 우회 대출을 막을 방안을 다각도로 검토하겠다”고 답했다.)

◇Discussed the Idea of Introducing a 1% 'Macroprudential Management Levy' for High-Priced Home Loans (◇고가주택 대출 시 1% ‘거시건전성 관리부담금’ 신설 구상도 논의)

The debate also covered the idea of introducing a 'macroprudential management levy'—a type of fee imposed on loans for ultra-expensive homes to serve as a resource for stabilizing housing for ordinary citizens. When researcher Kim Young-do proposed imposing a certain percentage of the loan amount as a fee to alleviate asset disparity arising from ultra-expensive home loans, President Lee inquired about the specific levy level. Kim suggested, "For example, applying a 1% fee on a 1 billion won loan (approximately 10 million won)." (이날 토론에서는 초고가 주택 대출에 일종의 부담금을 부과해 서민 주거 안정 재원으로 활용하는 ‘거시건전성 관리 부담금’ 신설 아이디어도 다뤄졌다. 김영도 연구원이 초고가 주택 대출을 활용한 자산 격차를 완화하기 위해 대출액의 일정 비율을 부담금으로 부과하는 방안을 제안하자, 이 대통령은 구체적인 부과 수준을 물었다. 김 연구원은 “예를 들어 10억원 대출 시 1% 수준(약 1000만원)을 부과하는 방식”을 예시로 제시했다.)

President Lee noted, "As it's a new system, there may be considerable resistance and debate," but expressed meaningful interest in the purpose of curbing loan overheating using high-priced homes and redirecting the proceeds to secure housing for ordinary citizens. (이 대통령은 “새로운 제도인 만큼 저항과 논쟁이 많을 수 있겠다”면서도 고가 주택을 활용한 대출 과열을 억제하고 그 수익을 서민 주거 확보로 환원하는 취지에 유의미한 관심을 표했다.)

item.title: Lee: "Real estate ratio highest in the world... Will take responsibility for policies despite criticism" (李 “부동산 비율 세계 최고… 비난 감수하고 정책 책임질 것”)
item.description:
Lee: "Real estate ratio highest in the world... Will take responsibility for policies despite criticism" (李 “부동산 비율 세계 최고… 비난 감수하고 정책 책임질 것”)

President Lee Jae-myung attended the "National Debate on Real Estate Policy" on the 23rd and stated that if real estate prices peak and a bubble bursts, the country could fall into a long-term recession like Japan's "Lost 30 Years." He emphasized normalizing the real estate market through social consensus and decisive action by public officials. (이재명 대통령은 23일 ‘부동산 정책 국민 대토론회’에 참석해, 부동산 가격이 정점에 달해 버블이 터질 경우 일본과 같은 ‘잃어버린 30년’의 장기 침체에 빠질 수 있다고 했다. 그러면서 사회적 합의와 공직자의 결단을 통한 부동산 시장 정상화를 강조했다.)

◇"Real estate asset ratio at world's highest level... Warning of Japan's 'Lost 30 Years' scenario" (◇“부동산 자산 비중 세계 최고 수준… 일본 ‘잃어버린 30년’ 수순 경고”)

In his opening remarks, President Lee said, "Among the asset holdings of South Korean citizens, the proportion of real estate is among the highest in the world," and "There are significant concerns that we might be racing toward a peak, similar to how demand concentrated in specific regions and prices rose in Japan before the bubble burst, leading to the 'Lost 30 Years' of hardship." (이 대통령은 이날 모두 발언을 통해 “대한민국 국민의 자산 보유 현황 중 부동산 비율은 전 세계에서 가장 높은 축에 속한다”며 “특정 지역에 수요가 집중되고 가격이 오르다 어느 한계점에서 버블이 터지면서 일본이 ‘잃어버린 30년’의 어려움을 겪었던 것처럼, 우리도 그 정점을 향해 달리고 있는 것 아니냐는 우려가 크다”고 했다.)

He added, "It is time for fundamental real estate measures based on capital market principles and public consensus, breaking away from the distorted perception that prices rise under one administration and fall under another." However, he also pointed out limitations, saying, "In the past, during the expansion of the metropolitan area, we released greenbelt zones to create new cities, but now it's difficult to find land within downtown Seoul, and opposition from existing residents is strong." He also noted, "Demand for purchasing or borrowing to accumulate properties worth 3 billion won rather than 300 million won—driven by speculative and non-genuine needs—is driving up housing prices." (이어 “어떤 정권이 들어서면 오르고, 어떤 정권이 들어서면 내린다는 식의 왜곡된 인식을 깨고, 자본시장 원리와 국민적 공감대에 기반한 근본적인 부동산 대책이 필요한 시점”이라고 했다. 반면 “과거 수도권 팽창기에는 그린벨트를 풀어 신도시를 만들었지만, 이제는 서울 도심 내 택지를 찾기 어렵고 기존 주민들의 반대도 거세다”며 한계를 짚기도 했다. “3억원짜리보다 30억원짜리를 사거나 대출을 받아 사 모으는 가수요 및 투기 수요가 집값을 끌어올리고 있다”고도 했다.)

President Lee remarked, "Finance is a quasi-public resource based on the state's monetary authority," and "A policy judgment is needed on whether it is desirable to allocate financial resources to borrowing for speculation and investment purposes—which raises housing prices and harms actual residents." He added that the tax system, beyond its original purpose of securing revenue, should also find a reasonable balance in its excessive use to suppress demand. (이 대통령은 “금융은 국가 발권력에 기반한 반공적 자원”이라며 “투기와 투자 목적으로 돈을 빌려 집값을 올리고 실거주자에게 피해를 주는 행위에 금융 자원을 배치하는 것이 바람직한지 정책적 판단이 필요하다”고 했다. 조세 제도 역시 재정 확보라는 본래 목적 외에 수요 억제용으로 과도하게 활용하는 것에 대한 합리적 선을 찾아야 한다고 덧붙였다.)

◇"Power is the force to reconcile interests... Will make decisions responsibly despite criticism" (◇“권력은 이해관계 조정하는 힘… 비난 감수하고 책임지고 결단할 것”)

President Lee clearly expressed his determination to boldly confront the inevitable conflicts arising from real estate policy implementation. He said, "Power is the force to reduce speculation based on facts, reconcile interests as much as possible, and forcibly arrive at a final conclusion when there is a gap that cannot be bridged through consensus," adding, "Granting great authority to elected officials means they are meant to make such decisions. The greatest virtue of a public official is to take responsibility for the people's lives and livelihoods, even if it invites criticism and resistance." (이 대통령은 부동산 정책 추진 과정에서 불가피하게 발생하는 갈등에 대해 정면 돌파하겠다는 의지를 분명히 했다. 이 대통령은 “팩트에 기반해 억측을 줄이고 이해관계를 최대한 조정하되, 끝내 합의에 이르지 못하는 간극이 생겼을 때 강제로 최종 결론에 이르게 하는 힘이 바로 권력”이라며 “선출직 공무원에게 큰 권한을 맡긴 것은 그런 결단을 하라는 뜻이다. 비난과 저항이 따르더라도 국민의 삶과 민생을 위해 책임지는 것이 공직자의 최대 덕목이다”라고 했다.)

President Lee mentioned his upcoming long trip to Central and South America starting on the 24th and urged Prime Minister Han Sung-sook to lead follow-up measures from the debate and maintain additional communication to ensure no delays in legal deadlines, such as the revision of tax laws. (이 대통령은 24일부터 예정된 중남미 장기 순방 일정을 언급하며, 세법 개정 시한 등 법적 일정에 차질이 없도록 한성숙 국무총리를 중심으로 토론회 후속 조치와 추가적인 소통을 이어가 줄 것을 당부했다.)

item.title: Lee: "It's Not About Forcing Home Prices Down... Prices Based on Legitimate Demand Will Be Respected" (李 “억지로 집값 낮추자는 거 아냐... 정당한 수요에 따른 가격은 존중”)
item.description:
Lee: "It's Not About Forcing Home Prices Down... Prices Based on Legitimate Demand Will Be Respected" (李 “억지로 집값 낮추자는 거 아냐... 정당한 수요에 따른 가격은 존중”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 23rd regarding the goals of real estate policy, "It's not about forcibly driving down prices," and added, "Market prices formed based on legitimate demand and appropriate supply should be respected." (이재명 대통령은 23일 부동산 정책 목표에 대해 “억지로 가격을 낮추자는 아니다”라며 “정당한 수요, 적정한 공급에 따라서 만들어진 시장 가격은 존중해야 되겠다”고 했다.)

The President made these remarks during a national debate on real estate policy held at the KBS Annex in Yeouido, Seoul, responding to a question about whether suppressing or manipulating demand and supply would resemble a socialist state. (이 대통령은 이날 서울 여의도 KBS 별관에서 열린 부동산정책 국민 대토론회에서 수요와 공급을 억제하거나 어떻게 조정하겠다고 하면, 그게 사회주의 국가에 가깝지 않느냐”며 이같이 말했다.)

President Lee said, "In the current advanced economic situation of South Korea, completely ignoring market order and forcibly manipulating demand and supply, or implementing price controls to lower or raise prices, is difficult to set as a policy goal. Rather, it's about preventing abnormal demand and supply from distorting prices and normalizing them." <<> The President reiterated the stance of imposing differentiated burdens on ultra-high-priced homes. He stated, "If someone says, 'I want an apartment overlooking the Han River no matter the price, because I can afford it, and I'm willing to pay any taxes needed,' I believe that should be respected. However, it's necessary to impose a corresponding social burden. Market prices formed based on legitimate demand and appropriate supply should be respected." <<> President Lee remarked, "The concept of a single 'prime home' has actually caused serious problems in our society. In the process of respecting and protecting single-home ownership, we treated expensive and cheap homes the same, which allowed people to efficiently buy one home and enjoy investment gains." <<> He continued, "Because we didn't distinguish between residential use and investment or speculative use, something huge erupted from a small crack. When one area rises, others follow. One of the ideas to regulate this is to suppress ultra-high-priced homes." (이 대통령은 “지금과 같은 발전한 대한민국 경제 상황에서 시장 질서를 완전히 무시하고 수요와 공급을 억지로 어떻게든 해서, 아니면 가격 통제를 해서 가격을 낮추자거나 높이자는 것은 정책 목표가 되기 어렵다”며 “다만 비정상적인 수요 공급에 의해서 가격이 잘못 형성되는 거를 막자, 정상화하자는 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: ROK-U.S.-Japan Meeting in Two Weeks… China’s ICBM, Taiwan Issue Missing from Foreign Ministry Statement (2주 만에 만난 한·미·일… 中 ICBM, 대만 문제 다 빠진 외교부 발표)
item.description:
ROK-U.S.-Japan Meeting in Two Weeks… China’s ICBM, Taiwan Issue Missing from Foreign Ministry Statement (2주 만에 만난 한·미·일… 中 ICBM, 대만 문제 다 빠진 외교부 발표)

The State Department announced that Secretary Marco Rubio met on the 22nd with South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul and Japanese Foreign Minister Takeshi Iwaya on the sidelines of the ASEAN Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Manila, the Philippines, for a U.S.-South Korea-Japan trilateral foreign ministers' meeting. Spokesperson Tammy Pit said the three foreign ministers "highlighted the importance of trilateral cooperation with ASEAN on mutual interests, including strengthening defense cooperation and maritime security, enhancing energy security, countering cyber threats, and promoting peace and stability in Southeast Asia and the broader Indo-Pacific region." Amid this, a significant temperature difference between the U.S. and South Korea was detected over North Korea and Taiwan issues. (국무부는 마코 루비오 장관이 22일 필리핀 마닐라에서 열린 아세안(ASEAN·동남아국가연합) 외교장관 회의를 계기로 조현 외교부 장관, 모테기 도시미쓰(茂木敏充) 일본 외무상과 만나 한·미·일 외교장관 회의를 가졌다고 밝혔다. 토미 피곳 대변인은 이날 3국 외교 장관이 “국방 협력 및 해양 안보 강화, 에너지 안보 증진, 사이버 위협 대응, 동남아시아 및 더 넓은 인도·태평양 지역의 평화와 안정 증진 등 상호 관심사에 대한 아세안과의 협력의 중요성을 강조했다”고 밝혔다. 이런 가운데 북한·대만 문제를 놓고 한미 간 상당한 온도 차가 감지 됐다.)

This meeting took place as maritime disputes between the Philippines and China in the South China Sea intensify by the day. Just before the meeting, on the 20th, Chinese coast guard officers wielded wooden clubs against Philippine troops at Second Thomas Shoal, leading the State Department to "condemn aggressive acts." While the Permanent Court of Arbitration (PCA) under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) ruled in 2016 that China's South China Sea claims lacked legal basis, China has rejected this, drawing its "nine-dash line" corresponding to its own territorial waters concept and claiming sovereignty over most of the sea area. Rubio met with Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., emphasizing an "ironclad" alliance and the importance of freedom of navigation and overflight in the South China Sea. He also discussed this issue with foreign ministers of the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue (QUAD), a multilateral security consultative body. (이번 회의는 남중국해에서 필리핀과 중국의 해상 분쟁이 날이 갈수록 격화되고 있는 가운데 열렸다. 회의 직전인 지난 20일 세컨드 토머스 암초에서 중국 해경이 필리핀군을 상대로 나무 곤봉을 휘두르는 일이 벌어져 국무부가 “공격적 행위를 규탄한다”고 했다. 2016년 국제해양법재판소(ITLOS) 산하 상설중재재판소(PCA)가 중국의 남중국해 영유권 주장에 근거가 없다고 판결했지만, 중국은 이를 인정하지 않은 채 자체 영해 개념에 해당하는 ‘구단선(九段線)’을 남중국해에 긋고 수역 대부분에 대한 영유권을 주장하고 있다. 루비오는 페르디난드 마르코스 주니어 필리핀 대통령과 만나 ‘철통(ironclad)’ 같은 동맹, 남중국해에서의 항행(航行)·상공 비행의 자유 중요성 등을 강조했다. 또 다자(多者) 안보 협의체 쿼드(QUAD) 외교장관과도 만나 이 문제를 논의했다.)

The State Department's spokesperson statement indicated that the three ministers "emphasized the importance of maintaining peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait." It also said they "expressed concern" over China's recent launch of an intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) into the Pacific with insufficient prior notice. This launch provoked strong backlash from Japan, Australia, and others, but South Korea, geographically close to China, only stated a principled position of "closely monitoring." Notably, these points were not included in the outcome press release from the South Korean Foreign Ministry. Regarding North Korea, the State Department statement said, "They affirmed shared commitment to complete denuclearization of North Korea (DPRK) and continued cooperation in responding to North Korean cyber threats and illicit activities, and to work for immediate resolution of the abduction issue." In contrast, the Foreign Ministry used the phrase "principle of denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula," omitting mention of North Korean cyber threats and the abduction issue, and stated they "agreed to continue communication and cooperation through dialogue and diplomacy." (국무부가 발표한 대변인 명의 발언을 보면 3국 장관이 “대만 해협 전역의 평화·안정을 유지하는 것이 중요함을 강조했다”고 돼 있다. 또 중국이 최근 태평양으로 대륙간탄도미사일(ICBM)을 발사하면서 충분한 사전 통보를 하지 않은 점에 대해 “우려를 표명한다”고 했다. 이 발사는 일본, 호주 등의 강한 반발을 낳았는데 정작 중국 지근거리에 있는 한국은 ‘예의주시하고 있다’는 원론적인 입장을 표명하는 데 그쳤다. 특히 이런 내용은 외교부가 전한 회의 결과 보도자료에는 담기지 않았다. 북한 문제 역시 국무부 발표를 보면 “북한(DPRK)에 대한 완전한 비핵화에 대한 공동의 의지를 강조하고 북한의 사이버 위협 및 불법 활동에 대응하기 위한 지속적인 협력, 납치 문제의 즉각적인 해결을 위해 노력하기로 한다”고 했다. 반면 외교부는 ‘한반도 비핵화 원칙’이란 표현을 사용하면서 북한의 사이버 위협, 납치 문제에 대한 언급 없이 “대화와 외교를 통한 소통과 협력을 지속해 나가기로 했다”고 했다.)

Earlier this month, on the 10th anniversary of the PCA ruling, the U.S. led a joint statement with Japan, Australia, New Zealand, and other Indo-Pacific allies urging China to comply with international law, which South Korea did not join. The statement also included countries belonging to the "free and democratic camp" in the international community, such as Germany and the UK. Typically, when foreign ministers meet, what each country deems important is specified in press releases, but under the Lee Jae-myung administration, differing U.S. and South Korean statements have become a recurring pattern. The State Department stated that the three ministers "reaffirmed a shared opposition to economic coercion and the weaponization of supply chains while emphasizing the importance of economic security," with phrases like "economic coercion" and "weaponization of supply chains" commonly used when targeting China. (이달 초에도 PCA 판결 10주년을 맞아 미국이 주도해 일본, 호주, 뉴질랜드 등 인·태 지역 동맹국이 중국의 국제법 준수를 촉구하는 공동 성명을 발표했지만 한국은 여기에 불참한 것으로 나타났다. 이 성명에는 독일, 영국 등 국제 사회에서 ‘자유·민주 진영’에 속하는 나라들이 이름을 올렸다. 통상 외교장관 회담을 하면 각국이 중요하게 생각하는 것을 보도자료에 적시하는데, 이재명 정부 들어선 한미 간 발표가 상이한 모습이 반복되고 있다. 국무부는 3국 장관이 “경제 안보의 중요성을 강조하면서 경제적 강압 및 공급망의 무기화에 대한 공동의 반대 입장을 재확인했다”고 밝혔는데, ‘경제적 강압(economic coercion)’과 ‘공급망 무기화(weaponization of supply chains)’는 중국을 겨냥할 때 단골로 등장하는 문구다.)

Meanwhile, meeting with reporters, Rubio was asked whether the U.S. has requested Asian allies, including South Korea, to contribute naval assets in the Strait of Hormuz. He replied, "We did not make that request today, but they heavily rely on oil and natural gas supplied from (the Middle East), and I think doing so would benefit them." Rubio added, "We've had those conversations in the past, and each country has different constraints to go through for approval. I think it would be beneficial if they did. Some of these countries have special capabilities in mine clearance or similar areas." <<>> (한편 루비오는 이날 기자들과 만나 ‘미국이 한국 등 아시아 동맹에 호르무즈 해협에 대한 해군 자산 등의 기여를 요청했냐’는 질문에 “오늘 그런 요청을 하지 않았다”면서도 “그들은 (중동에서) 공급되는 석유와 천연가스에 크게 의존하고 있다. (기여하면) 그들에게 이익이 되는 것이라 생각한다”고 했다. 루비오는 “과거에 그런 대화를 나눈 적이 있고 각국은 이를 승인 받기 위해 거쳐야 할 제약들이 다르다”며 “그렇게 한다면 유익할 것이라 생각한다. 이들 국가 중 일부는 기뢰 제거나 유사한 분야에서 특별한 능력을 보유하고 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: North Korea Skips ASEAN Forum for Second Consecutive Year, Tightening Ties with China and Russia While Distancing from Multilateralism (2년 연속 아세안포럼 불참한 北... 다자 거리두며 중·러와 밀착)
item.description:
North Korea Skips ASEAN Forum for Second Consecutive Year, Tightening Ties with China and Russia While Distancing from Multilateralism (2년 연속 아세안포럼 불참한 北... 다자 거리두며 중·러와 밀착)

North Korea did not attend the ASEAN Regional Forum (ARF) held in Manila, Philippines on the 23rd (local time) for the second consecutive year. Analysts suggest that North Korea is continuing its trend of focusing on bilateral diplomacy with China and Russia rather than multilateral forums like the ARF. (북한이 23일(현지 시각) 필리핀 마닐라에서 열린 아세안지역안보포럼(ARF)에 2년 연속 참석하지 않았다. 북한이 ARF 등 다자외교보다 중국과 러시아 등과 양자외교에 주력하는 기조를 이어가고 있다는 분석이 나온다.)

The ARF is the only regional multilateral security consultative body that North Korea has participated in, with foreign ministers from key countries involved in regional issues, including the United States, China, Japan, and Russia, in attendance. The North Korean delegation ultimately did not appear at the ARF held at the Philippine International Convention Center (PICC) that day. (ARF는 북한이 참여해온 유일한 역내 다자 안보 협의체로, 미국, 중국, 일본, 러시아 등 역내 현안에 관계가 있는 주요국 외교장관들이 참석한다. 이날 필리핀국제컨벤션센터(PICC)에서 열린 ARF에 북한 대표단은 끝내 모습을 드러내지 않았다.)

Since joining the ARF in 2000, North Korea had used it as a multilateral diplomatic platform to engage with regional countries. It also engaged in intense diplomatic battles with South Korea over the chair’s statement. (북한은 지난 2000년 ARF에 가입한 뒤 역내 국가들과 접촉하는 다자외교 무대로 활용해왔다. 의장 성명을 둘러싸고 한국과 치열한 외교전을 벌이기도 했다.)

Starting in 2019, when the second U.S.-North Korea summit collapsed, North Korea lowered the level of its delegation by sending the ambassador to the host country or the ambassador to ASEAN as the head delegate instead of the foreign minister, and last year, it skipped the forum for the first time since joining. (북한은 2차 미·북 정상회담이 결렬된 2019년부터 외무상 대신 개최국 주재 대사나 주아세안대표부 대사를 수석대표로 보내며 대표단의 격을 낮췄고, 지난해에는 가입 이후 처음으로 불참했다.)

Analysts view that North Korea is prioritizing bilateral diplomacy over multilateral platforms as it moves closer to China and Russia. North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui visited Moscow just before the ARF, meeting with President Vladimir Putin on the 19th and holding the "Third North Korea-Russia Strategic Dialogue" with Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov on the 20th. (북한이 중국·러시아와 밀착 행보를 보이는 상황에서 다자 외교 무대보다는 양자 외교에 무게를 두는 것으로 분석된다. 북한 최선희 외무상은 ARF 직전 러시아 모스크바를 방문해 지난 19일 블라디미르 푸틴 대통령을 만난 데 이어 20일 세르게이 라브로프 외무장관과 ‘북·러 제3차 전략대화’를 열었다.)

From North Korea's perspective, with the United States also prioritizing issues like the Middle East, it likely judged that the practical benefits of multilateral diplomacy through the ARF are not significant. (북한 입장에서는 미국도 중동 문제 등에 우선순위를 두는 상황에서 ARF를 통한 다자 외교에서 얻을 실익이 크지 않다고 판단했을 가능성도 있다.)

The South Korean government focused on explaining its policies on the Korean Peninsula, including North Korea issues, through various consultations held during this round of ASEAN foreign ministers' meetings, including the ARF. (정부는 ARF 등 이번 아세안 외교장관 회의를 계기로 열린 각종 협의를 통해 현 정부의 대북 문제를 포함해 한반도 정책을 설명하는 데 주력했다.)

A foreign ministry official stated, "Minister Cho Hyun provided a detailed explanation of the situation on the Korean Peninsula to participating countries, expressing concerns that cooperation between North Korea, China, and Russia is being conducted in a way that is not helpful to the situation on the Korean Peninsula." (외교부 당국자는 “조현 장관이 참석국들에 한반도 정세를 상세히 설명하면서 북한이 중국과 러시아 사이를 활용하는 과정에서 한반도 정세에 도움이 되지 않는 방향으로 협력이 이뤄지는 데 대한 우려를 전달했다”고 밝혔다.)

He added, "Since ASEAN values problem-solving through dialogue, it understands and supports the direction of our government's approach, and we expect this stance to be reflected in the chair's statement and other documents." (이어 “아세안은 대화를 통한 문제 해결을 중시하는 만큼 우리 정부의 접근 방향을 잘 이해·지지하고 있고, 의장 성명 등에도 이러한 기조가 반영될 것으로 기대한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Lee: "Even if not residing, if it's for residential use, it should be treated like actual residence" (李 “비거주해도 거주용이라면 실거주와 같이 취급해야”)
item.description:
Lee: "Even if not residing, if it's for residential use, it should be treated like actual residence" (李 “비거주해도 거주용이라면 실거주와 같이 취급해야”)

President Lee Jae-myung said on the 23rd, "If you own a house for residential purposes and are temporarily not residing due to other circumstances, but if it's intended for residential use, shouldn’t it be treated the same as actual residence?" During the "National Debate on Real Estate Policy" held that morning at the KBS Annex in Yeouido, Seoul, the President stated, "Let’s stop saying 'actual residence' and instead use the standard of 'residential use' or 'for living purposes' moving forward." (이재명 대통령은 23일 “거주용으로 (주택을) 가지고 있는데 다른 사정 때문에 잠깐 비거주하지만 이게 거주용이라고 하면 실거주와 똑같이 취급해야 하는 것 아니냐”고 했다. 이 대통령은 이날 오전 서울 여의도 KBS 별관에서 열린 ‘부동산 정책 국민 대토론회’에서 “실거주라고 하지 말고 앞으로 구분 기준을 거주용, 주거용으로 하자”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

President Lee added, "When we talk about a single home for actual residence, many people point out, 'What about cases where I have to move temporarily due to work?' or 'What if I need to be hospitalized?' In my case, because I stay at the presidential residence in Cheong Wa Dae, my own home is empty, and there were criticisms like, 'Isn’t your Bundang apartment non-residential?' or 'It’s not for actual residence, right?'" He continued, "I suggested that we change the terminology going forward. Let’s stop calling it 'actual residence' and instead call it 'residential use.'" (이 대통령은 “우리가 실거주 1주택이라고 할 때 ‘내가 잠깐 직장 때문에 (주거지를) 옮기는 것은 어떻게 하라는 거냐’, ‘입원해야 하는데 어쩌라는 거냐’ 이런 지적이 많다”며 “저 같은 경우 청와대 공관에 있다 보니 집이 비었는데 ‘너는 (분당 아파트) 비거주용 아니냐’, ‘실거주용 아니잖아’ 이런 지적이 있지 않았느냐”라고 했다. 이어 “(제가) 앞으로는 용어를 바꾸자고 했다”면서 “실거주라고 하지 말고, 거주용이라고 하자”고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: Civil Servants Making ‘Hate Speech’ Face Minimum Pay Cut, Maximum Dismissal Discipline (‘혐오 발언’ 공무원은 최소 감봉, 최대 파면 징계)
item.description:
Civil Servants Making ‘Hate Speech’ Face Minimum Pay Cut, Maximum Dismissal Discipline (‘혐오 발언’ 공무원은 최소 감봉, 최대 파면 징계)

The government has decided that civil servants who make statements deemed ‘hate speech’ will face at least a pay cut and at most dismissal from office. The disciplinary level for civil servants engaging in ‘passive administration’ will also be tightened from a minimum of reprimand to at least a pay cut. (정부가 ‘혐오 표현’이라고 판단되는 발언을 한 공무원을 최소 감봉, 최대 파면 징계하기로 했다. ‘소극 행정’을 한 공무원에 대한 징계 수위도 견책 이상에서 감봉 이상으로 강화한다.)

The Ministry of Personnel Management announced on the 23rd that it will pre-announce legislation for a revised enforcement rule of the Civil Servant Disciplinary Decree containing these measures. The ministry plans to finalize the revised rule by reflecting opinions gathered during the pre-announcement period and implement it starting October 1. (인사혁신처는 이 같은 내용을 담은 공무원 징계령 시행규칙 개정안을 23일 입법 예고한다고 밝혔다. 인사처는 입법 예고 기간에 수렴한 의견을 반영해 시행규칙을 개정하고, 10월 1일 시행할 예정이다.)

Currently, there are no disciplinary standards for civil servants who make hate speech. The revision specifies hate speech as a type of violation of the duty to maintain dignity for civil servants, subjecting them to discipline. It also prohibits issuing a reprimand for such cases, mandating at least a pay cut and up to dismissal. Meanwhile, while standard discipline can be mitigated by one level if the civil servant has a record of receiving awards, this mitigation will not apply when being disciplined for hate speech. (지금은 공무원이 혐오 표현을 한 경우에 대한 징계 기준이 없다. 개정안은 혐오 표현을 공무원의 품위 유지 의무 위반의 일종으로 규정해 징계하도록 했다. 또 견책 징계는 줄 수 없게 하고, 무조건 감봉 이상, 최대 파면 징계를 주도록 했다. 한편 통상적인 징계는 해당 공무원에게 상을 받은 실적이 있으면 한 단계 감경될 수 있는데, 혐오 표현으로 징계를 받을 때는 이런 감경도 받지 못하게 하기로 했다.)

The ministry stated that the criteria for what constitutes hate speech will be established by referencing various laws. For example, the Information and Communications Network Act defines online posts that “publicly incite direct violence or discrimination against specific individuals or groups based on race, nationality, region, gender, disability, age, social status, income level, or property status” or “seriously promote hatred, significantly undermining the human dignity of specific individuals or groups” as ‘illegal information.’ Expressions falling under such definitions could be deemed hate speech. (인사처는 무엇을 혐오 표현으로 볼 것인지에 관한 기준은 여러 법률을 참조해 만들기로 했다고 밝혔다. 예를 들어, 정보통신망법은 “공공연하게 인종, 국가, 지역, 성별, 장애, 연령, 사회적 신분, 소득 수준 또는 재산 상태를 이유로 특정 개인이나 집단에 대해 직접적인 폭력이나 차별을 선동”하거나 “증오심을 심각하게 조장하여 특정 개인이나 집단의 인간으로서의 존엄성을 현저히 훼손”하는 온라인 게시물 등을 ‘불법 정보’로 규정하는데, 이와 같은 표현을 한 경우는 혐오 표현으로 판정될 수 있다.)

Additionally, if a civil servant fails to perform duties they should reasonably carry out or neglects their work, infringing on citizens’ rights or causing financial loss to the state, they will face discipline for ‘passive administration,’ with the minimum disciplinary level raised from reprimand to pay cut. A new clause on managerial responsibility will also be introduced, allowing managers to be disciplined alongside subordinates in cases of severe passive administration. (한편 공무원이 마땅히 해야 할 일을 하지 않았거나 일을 태만히 해 국민의 권익을 침해하거나 국가에 재정상 손실을 입히는 경우에는 ‘소극 행정’으로 징계를 받게 되는데, 징계의 최소 수위가 견책에서 감봉으로 상향된다. 또 관리자의 책임을 묻는 조항을 신설해, 소극 행정이 심한 경우에는 관리자도 함께 징계를 받을 수 있게 된다.)

President Lee Jae-myung said at a cabinet meeting in November last year, “Racial hate or discrimination, and the distribution of false information that distorts or manipulates facts, are acts that threaten democracy and are crimes that must be expelled.” In response, Minister of Personnel Management Choi Dong-seok stated, “If a civil servant makes hate speech while in office, they will be automatically dismissed, and regardless of criminal punishment, they will be held strictly accountable through disciplinary measures.” (이재명 대통령은 지난해 11월 국무회의에서 “인종 혐오나 차별, 사실관계를 왜곡·조작하는 잘못된 정보의 유통은 민주주의를 위협하는 행위이자 추방해야 할 범죄”라고 했다. 이에 최동석 인사처장은 “공무원이 재직 중 혐오 발언을 하는 경우 당연 퇴직되도록 하고, 형사처벌과 관계없이 징계를 통해 엄중히 책임을 물을 것”이라고 했었다.)

item.title: Lee: "Differential application of property taxes for single-home owners... Exemptions for actual residents, heavier taxes for high-value homes" (李 “1주택 보유세 차등 적용... 실거주는 감면, 고가는 가중”)
item.description:
Lee: "Differential application of property taxes for single-home owners... Exemptions for actual residents, heavier taxes for high-value homes" (李 “1주택 보유세 차등 적용... 실거주는 감면, 고가는 가중”)

At the "National Debate on Real Estate Policy" held on the 23rd, President Lee Jae-myung stated that to align South Korea's property taxes (property tax and comprehensive real estate tax) with those of advanced countries, they would need to be raised at least threefold. However, given the immense real-world resistance, he plans to establish a system of fine-tuning and differential taxation to prevent a market explosion, even at the cost of political losses. (이재명 대통령이 23일 열린 ‘부동산 정책 국민 대토론회’에서 부동산 보유세(재산세·종합부동산세)를 선진국 수준으로 맞추려면 최소 3배는 올려야 하지만 현실적 저항이 막대한 만큼, 정치적 손해를 감수하더라도 시장 폭발을 막을 미세 조정 및 차등 과세 체계를 마련하겠다고 했다.)

◇"Tripling property taxes would cause a riot… Forcing it now is difficult, but neglect is fatal" (◇“보유세 3배 올리면 폭동 수준… 당장 강행 어렵지만 방치는 치명적”)

President Lee said, "To bring our property taxes up to the typical level of advanced countries, we would need to raise them at least threefold," but added, "If we tripled them right now, wouldn't it cause a situation close to a riot?" However, he continued, "If we leave it as is, it might strike whoever is in a future generation, but it will deliver a tremendous shock to South Korea and eventually explode. Since it would be fatal when it does, we must prepare for it, even at the cost of political losses." (이 대통령은 “우리나라 보유세를 통상적인 선진국 수준으로 맞추려면 최하 3배는 올려야 한다”면서도 “지금 당장 3배를 올리면 아마 거의 폭동 비슷한 상황이 벌어지지 않겠느냐”고 했다. 그러나 “이대로 두면 어느 세대에 누가 당할지 모르지만 대한민국에 엄청난 충격을 주고 언젠가는 터질 것”이라며 “터지면 치명적인 만큼, 정치적 손해를 보더라도 이에 대한 대비는 반드시 해야 한다”고 했다.)

◇Creating a basic 'standard single-home' framework… Exemptions for actual residents and regional areas vs. heavier taxes on ultra-high-value homes and multiple-home owners (◇‘표준 1주택’ 기본 틀 신설… 실거주·지방 감면 vs 초고가·다주택 가중)

The plan proposed by President Lee is a 'stepwise differential taxation system centered on a basic baseline.' It aims to precisely arrange exemption and weight factors based on a standard single home. President Lee stated, "We will set an appropriate basic property burden based on a typical single home, then grant exemption benefits for actual residence purposes, homes for ordinary and middle-class people, or regional factors. Conversely, we are considering adding weight factors for luxury and ultra-high-value homes, multiple-home ownership, and non-resident homes with clear speculative purposes, creating stepwise differentiation." (이 대통령이 제시한 방안은 ‘기본 기준선 설정을 통한 단계적 차등 과세 체계’다. 표준적 1주택을 기준으로 감면과 가중 요소를 정교하게 배치하겠다는 것이다. 이 대통령은 “통상적인 1주택을 기준으로 적정한 기본 보유 부담을 설정한 뒤, 실거주 용도나 서민·중산층용 주택, 지방 지역 요인에는 감면 혜택을 주겠다”며 “반대로 호화·초고가 주택, 다주택, 명백한 투기 목적의 비거주 주택에는 가중 요소를 더해 단계적으로 차등을 두는 방안을 고민하고 있다”고 했다.)

In other words, single-home owners with actual demand or those with little tax burden capacity, such as regional or ordinary people's homes, would see their tax burden lowered for protection, while the tax reins would be tightened tightly on ultra-high-value homes or non-resident multiple-home owners. (즉, 실수요 목적의 1주택자나 세 부담 여력이 적은 지방·서민 주택에는 세 부담을 오히려 낮춰 보호하되, 초고가 주택이나 비거주 다주택자에 대해서는 과세 고삐를 바짝 죄겠다는 뜻이다.)

◇"What level of tax burden is appropriate?" Gathering public opinion (◇“어느 정도 세 부담이 적정한가” 국민 의견 수렴)

President Lee announced that he would actively pursue gathering public opinion to determine specific guidelines for differential taxation and the appropriate level of tax burden. He said, "Since the differentiating factors—such as residence status, number of homes, price range, and regional factors—are very diverse, I want to hear vivid opinions from experts and the public on what level is appropriate." (이 대통령은 차등 과세의 구체적인 가이드라인과 적정 세 부담 수위를 정하기 위해 대국민 의견 수렴을 적극적으로 추진하겠다고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 “거주 유무, 주택 수, 가격대, 지역적 요인 등 차등 요소가 매우 다양한 만큼 어느 정도가 적정한 수준인지에 대해 전문가와 국민 여러분의 생생한 의견을 듣고 싶다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Reconstruction and redevelopment won't significantly increase number of households... rather, it may decrease" (李대통령 “재건축·재개발로 가구수 크게 안 늘어…오히려 줄어”)
item.description:
President Lee: "Reconstruction and redevelopment won't significantly increase number of households... rather, it may decrease" (李대통령 “재건축·재개발로 가구수 크게 안 늘어…오히려 줄어”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 23rd that even with reconstruction and redevelopment, the effect on housing supply is not clear. (이재명 대통령은 23일 재건축·재개발을 하더라도 주택 공급 효과가 뚜렷하지 않다고 밝혔다.)

President Lee made these remarks at the "National Debate on Real Estate Policy" held at the KBS annex in Yeouido, Seoul, saying, "There will be various types of reconstruction, redevelopment, and maintenance projects." He added, "Typically, in the case of reconstruction, the number of households may increase, but because the size per household also grows, it doesn't seem to increase significantly. In the case of redevelopment, the total number of occupying households usually decreases." (이 대통령은 이날 서울 여의도 KBS별관에서 열린 ‘부동산 정책 국민대토론회’에서 “재건축·재개발, 정비사업 여러 가지 유형이 있을 것”이라며 이같이 말했다. 이 대통령은 “통상적으로 재건축의 경우 가구 수가 늘어나는 경우가 있긴 하지만 (가구당) 평수가 늘어나기 때문에 그 역시도 크게 많이 늘어나는 것 같지는 않다”라며 “재개발의 경우는 총 입주 가구 수는 줄어드는 게 통상인 것 같다”고 했다.)

He further explained, "While redevelopment improves living conditions and supplies higher-quality housing, many existing residents have to leave, so the total number of households may actually decrease. There seems to be a debate over whether it can truly be seen as having an effect on new housing supply in overly dense areas." (이어 “(재개발이) 주거 환경은 개선되고, 품질 높은 주택이 공급되긴 하지만 기존에 있는 주민의 상당수가 떠나야 하는, 그래서 총가구 수는 오히려 줄어드는 측면도 있어 보인다”라면서 “과밀한 지역의 경우는 과연 신규 주택 공급 효과가 있다고 볼 수 있느냐에 대한 논쟁은 있는 것 같다”고 설명했다.)

Regarding suggestions about restricting redevelopment project reapplication when projects fail due to resident opposition, strengthening management and supervision of resident opinion collection, and regulating indiscriminate redevelopment, President Lee responded, "It doesn't seem to be within the government's authority, but we will take it into full consideration." (이 대통령은 주민 반대로 무산된 재개발 사업 재신청 제한, 주민 의견 수렴 관리·감독 강화, 무분별한 재개발 규제 관련 건의에 “정부 권한은 아닌 것 같은데 충분히 참고하도록 하겠다”고 했다.)

At the debate, the "slow progress of the 3rd new town projects" was cited as a major cause of the housing supply shortage that has worsened since 2022. Ko Jong-hwan, director of the Korea Asset Research Institute, who participated as a panelist at the debate, pointed directly to the stalled pace of the 3rd new town projects while analyzing the causes of the housing supply shortage that has been stimulating the jeonse and sales markets. (토론회에서는 2022년 이후 심화된 주택 공급 가뭄의 주요 원인으로 ‘3기 신도시 사업의 진척 부진’이 거론되기도 했다. 이날 토론회에서 패널로 참석한 고종환 한국자산연구원장은 최근 전세·매매 시장을 자극하는 주택 공급 부족의 원인을 분석하며 3기 신도시 사업의 속도 정체를 정면으로 짚었다.)

Director Ko stated, "The sharp decline in housing supply since 2022 is due to the depletion of new land in downtown Seoul, as well as the fact that the 3rd new town projects promoted by the previous government failed to progress on time and came to a halt. The combination of soaring construction costs and high interest rates caused us to miss the timing for timely supply through the 3rd new towns, which has heightened the current instability." He added, "Only by accelerating the speed of the government's 3rd new town development projects can we send a clear signal to the market that sufficient apartments will be supplied in the future." (고 원장은 “2022년 이후 주택 공급이 급감한 것은 서울 도심 내 신규 택지 고갈과 함께, 지난 정부에서 추진된 3기 신도시 사업이 제때 진척되지 못하고 멈춰 섰기 때문”이라며 “공사비 급등과 고금리 여파까지 겹치면서 3기 신도시를 통한 적기 공급 타이밍을 놓친 것이 현재의 불안을 키웠다”고 했다. 이어 “정부가 추진 중인 3기 신도시 조성 사업의 속도를 하루빨리 올려야만 시장에 ‘향후 충분한 아파트가 공급된다’는 확실한 시그널을 줄 수 있다”고 했다.)

Director Ko also urged, "The government and the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport should clearly distinguish between sound and unsound project sites, and provide selective PF support to get sound, viable sites back on track first." In response, President Lee said, "Internally, they say it takes about 60-some months, so we are internally reviewing ways to cut that period by more than half." (고 원장은 “정부와 국토부가 우량 사업장과 비우량 사업장을 명확히 구분해, 살릴 수 있는 우량 사업장부터 다시 돌아가도록 선별적인 PF 지원에 나서달라”고 당부하기도 했다. 이에 대해 이 대통령은 “내부적으로 육십몇 개월 걸린다고 그래서 저희가 (기간을) 절반 이하로 줄이기 위해 내부 검토 중”이라고 했다.)

President Lee stated, "The delay in groundbreaking for previously announced areas, including the 3rd new towns, is a truly serious problem. Administrative processes are too slow. Overall, if necessary, we plan to change regulations or run procedures in parallel to reduce the time." (이 대통령은 “3기 신도시를 포함해 기존에 발표된 지역의 착공이 지연되는 건 정말 심각한 문제”라면서 “행정 속도가 너무 느리다. 전체적으로 필요하면 규정을 바꾸든지, 절차를 병행해서 진행해 시간을 줄여볼 생각”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: No More Guard Duty... Ministry of National Defense: “Can Be Replaced by CCTV” (불침번 안 서도 되지 말입니다... 국방부 “CCTV로 대체 가능”)
item.description:
No More Guard Duty... Ministry of National Defense: “Can Be Replaced by CCTV” (불침번 안 서도 되지 말입니다... 국방부 “CCTV로 대체 가능”)

Among veterans who have served in the military, debates over “which guard duty shift is the best” could disappear. From now on, it appears that soldiers in military units that have introduced surveillance cameras (CCTV) may no longer need to stand guard duty at night, as reported on the 23rd. The Ministry of National Defense has pre-announced a partial amendment to the ‘Unit Management Directive’ containing these changes until August 10th. (군대를 다녀온 예비역들 사이에서 “몇번째 불침번이 가장 ‘꿀’이냐”는 토론이 사라질 수 있겠다. 앞으로 방범카메라(CCTV) 등을 도입한 군부대에서는 병사들이 야간에 불침번을 서지 않아도 될 것으로 23일 나타났다. 국방부는 이런 내용을 담은 ‘부대관리훈령’ 일부개정안을 오는 8월 10일까지 행정예고했다.)

The amendment allows commanders at the battalion level or higher to decide whether to forgo guard duty if the purpose of guard duty can be achieved through alternative verification systems, such as CCTV for perimeter security or unit management, and patrols. The Ministry of National Defense explained that it is amending the directive to grant units equipped with scientific perimeter operations and alternative means like unit management CCTV, along with verification systems, the authority to decide on guard duty operation. (개정안은 경계작전용 또는 부대관리용 CCTV와 순찰 등 대체 확인체계를 통해 불침번의 목적을 달성할 수 있다면 대대장급 이상 지휘관이 불침번 미운용 여부를 판단할 수 있도록 했다. 국방부는 과학화 경계작전과 부대관리용 CCTV 등 대체수단과 확인체계를 마련한 부대에 불침번 운용 판단 권한을 부여하기 위해 훈령을 개정한다고 설명했다.)

The current directive stipulates that guard duty is typically organized in pairs of two soldiers. Each shift is generally set to last between one and two hours, with duties performed in the living quarters or a location designated by the commander from immediately after evening roll call until wake-up the next day. The directive states that soldiers on guard duty must watch over the interior and exterior of buildings and must not leave their designated post, sit down, or smoke during their shift. This amendment to the directive creates the basis for eliminating guard duty. (현행 훈령은 불침번을 통상 2인 1조로 편성하도록 규정하고 있다. 한 차례 근무시간은 1시간 이상 2시간 이하가 원칙이며, 저녁점호 직후부터 다음 날 기상 때까지 생활관이나 지휘관이 정한 장소에서 근무한다. 불침번은 건물 내·외를 경계하며 근무 중 지정된 위치를 떠나거나 앉거나 담배를 피워서는 안된다고 훈령은 규정하고 있다. 이번 훈령 개정을 통해 불침번을 없앨 수 있는 근거를 만드는 것이다.)

In the Navy, Air Force, and Marine Corps, it is common not to maintain separate guard duty assignments after being assigned to a regular unit. Typically, duty officers perform guard duty tasks as well, so there is no guard duty operated solely by enlisted soldiers. (해군·공군·해병대는 자대 배치 이후에는 불침번을 따로 두지 않는 경우가 일반적이다. 통상 당직사관 등이 불침번 임무도 함께 수행하고 별도의 병사만으로 운용되는 불침번은 없는 것이다.)

In contrast, most Army units require two soldiers to serve as separate guard duty, in addition to the duty officer and duty soldier. The primary purpose is to prevent accidents resulting in casualties and to quickly verify the number of sleeping personnel in case of situations like desertion, allowing for immediate response. Guard duty itself reflects the Army’s characteristics, where incidents are frequent. However, with this directive amendment, it is expected that a significant portion of Army guard duties may also disappear. (반면 육군은 대다수 부대에서 당직사관 및 당직병 외에 별도로 병사 2명으로 구성된 불침번을 서도록 하고 있다. 인명사고 등을 예방하고, 탈영 등의 상황이 벌어졌을 때 즉각 대응할 수 있도록 취침인원 수를 확인하는 것이 주 목적이다. 불침번 자체가 사건 사고가 잦은 육군 특성을 반영한 것이다. 하지만 이번 훈령 개정으로 육군 불침번도 상당 부분 사라질 수 있다는 관측이 나온다.)

It has been reported that the Army has already had cases of eliminating guard duty by using CCTV. The Army’s 23rd Security Brigade reportedly centralized soldiers’ living spaces into a single floor last year, installed CCTV, and abolished guard duty. (이미 육군에서도 CCTV를 활용해 불침번을 없앤 사례가 있는 것으로 알려졌다. 육군 23경비여단은 지난해 병사 생활공간을 한 층으로 집중시키고 CCTV를 설치해 불침번을 폐지했다고 한다.)

However, it has been reported that not all military units will uniformly abolish guard duty. Each unit must assess whether CCTV and patrols can practically replace the role of existing guard duties. If the alternative verification system is insufficient or if guard duty is deemed necessary based on unit missions and security conditions, the existing duty system can continue to operate. (다만 모든 군부대에서 불침번을 일괄 폐지할 예정인 것은 아닌 것으로 알려졌다. CCTV와 순찰 등 기존 불침번의 역할을 실질적으로 대신할 수 있는지를 부대별로 판단해야 한다. 대체 확인체계가 충분하지 않거나 부대 임무와 경계 여건상 불침번이 필요하다고 판단되면 기존처럼 근무를 운용할 수 있다.)

Typically, the first guard duty shift starting around 10 PM is called “Chobeoncho” (First Shift), and the last shift is called “Malbeoncho” (Last Shift). Generally, the first and last shifts are considered the most comfortable because they allow for uninterrupted sleep. The second shift, which may be woken from light sleep to go on duty, and the shift just before the last, which involves waking up early in the morning and having only about an hour of sleep left after finishing duty, are the least preferred. <<>> (불침번은 보통 오후 10시 근무자를 초번초(1번초)라고 부르고 가장 마지막 근무자를 말번초라고 부른다. 통상 ‘통잠’을 잘 수 있는 초번초와 말번초를 가장 편한 근무로 평가한다. 선잠에 들었다가 근무에 투입될 가능성이 높은 2번초, 이른 새벽에 일어났다가 근무를 마치고 나면 취침시간이 약 1시간 안팎만 남는 말전초(말번초 직전 근무자)가 가장 비선호된다.)

item.title: Chung Dong-young: "Government Needs to Participate in Russia's Eastern Economic Forum" (정동영 “정부, 러 동방경제포럼 참여할 필요”)
item.description:
Chung Dong-young: "Government Needs to Participate in Russia's Eastern Economic Forum" (정동영 “정부, 러 동방경제포럼 참여할 필요”)

Chung Dong-young, Minister of Unification, stated on the 23rd regarding the Eastern Economic Forum (EEF) scheduled for September in Vladivostok, Russia, that "I think it is necessary to participate, though I'm not sure at what level (from the government)." (정동영 통일부 장관은 23일 오는 9월 러시아 블라디보스토크에서 열리는 러시아 동방경제포럼(EEF)과 관련해 “(정부 차원에서) 어떤 수준일지는 모르지만 참여하는 것이 필요하다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

At a press briefing held ahead of his first anniversary in office (the 25th), Minister Chung said, "Last year, the (government) delegation couldn't go due to various circumstances, but in the past, Presidents Park Geun-hye and Moon Jae-in, as well as Prime Minister Lee Nak-yon, have attended. President Putin will also be interested in improving Russia-Korea relations, so I think it's good for (our government) to participate from that perspective." (정 장관은 이날 취임 1주년(25일)을 앞두고 이뤄진 언론 간담회에서 “작년에는 이런저런 사정으로 (정부) 대표단이 못 갔는데 과거 박근혜·문재인 대통령, 이낙연 총리가 참석한 적이 있고 푸틴 대통령도 한러 관계 개선에 관심이 있을 것이므로 그런 차원에서 (우리 정부도)참여하는 게 좋다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

The EEF is a conference established by Russian President Vladimir Putin to promote economic development in Russia's Far East and maintain investment from Asia-Pacific countries. It has been held annually every September since 2015. This year, it is scheduled to take place from September 1 to 4. From the South Korean government, President Park Geun-hye attended in 2016, President Moon Jae-in in 2017, Prime Minister Lee Nak-yon in 2018, and Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance Hong Nam-ki in 2019. Since 2021, there has been no official government-level attendance. <<> At the briefing, Minister Chung said regarding inter-Korean relations, "The Unification Ministry's stance and belief is that nothing happens if you don't move," adding, "If we stay still, no one will solve the problems of peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula. We have to move." He further stated, "The President has spoken about the roles of peacemaker and pacemaker, (and to resume North Korea-U.S. dialogue) he is working hard to persuade President Trump and President Xi Jinping. In that regard, there is a point for reflection. As for whether the government is properly supporting the President's efforts and the pacemaker role well, the Unification Ministry has its regrets." <<> During the briefing, Minister Chung highlighted as one of his achievements since taking office the abandonment of the 'CVID (complete, verifiable, and irreversible denuclearization) method of denuclearization,' which refers to the complete denuclearization of North Korea. Minister Chung said, "We have essentially discarded the previous government's theory of preconditions for denuclearization and preconditions for nuclear abandonment, shifting the approach to one of preconditions for peace," and "Instead of the term 'denuclearization of North Korea,' we have re-established the goal as the realization of a nuclear-free Korean Peninsula." He added, "It has been seven years since inter-Korean dialogue was cut off, and the reality is that if you put preconditions for denuclearization at the very entrance of dialogue, the dialogue won't open. The theory of preconditions for peace embodies that awareness of the issue." <<> Minister Chung stated, "Looking at it from reality, the previous government's advocacy for preconditions for denuclearization can be seen as largely for domestic politics," and "First and foremost, stopping North Korea's nuclear activities is the top priority," adding, "Even at this moment, the centrifuges in North Korea's underground uranium enrichment facility are running, the 5MW (megawatt) reactor at Yongbyon that produces plutonium is also operating, and North Korea's nuclear warhead production capacity continues to increase." (EEF는 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령이 러시아의 극동 지역 경제 개발을 위해 아시아·태평양 국가들의 투자 유지 목적으로 창설한 회의다. 2015년부터 매년 9월에 개최된다. 올해는 오는 9월1일~4일 열릴 예정이다. 우리 정부에서는 2016년 박근혜 대통령, 2017년 문재인 대통령, 2018년 이낙연 국무총리, 2019년 홍남기 경제부총리 겸 기획재정부 장관이 참석했었다. 2021년 이후 정부 차원의 공식적인 참가는 이뤄지지 않고있다.)

item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae, who bounces back no matter how hard you step on him, faces the ‘poison prescription’ of pro-Myung faction and Shincheonji (밟아도 살아나는 정청래에 친명의 ‘독약 처방’ 신천지)
item.description:
Jeong Cheong-rae, who bounces back no matter how hard you step on him, faces the ‘poison prescription’ of pro-Myung faction and Shincheonji (밟아도 살아나는 정청래에 친명의 ‘독약 처방’ 신천지)

Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok has been raising suspicions daily about the religious group Shincheonji’s alleged interference in the Democratic Party’s national convention. He claims Shincheonji is secretly maneuvering to get a specific candidate elected. To prevent this, he also called for the elimination of ghost party members from Shincheonji. Some within the pro-Myung faction also argue that “Shincheonji is pushing former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae to plunge the Lee Jae-myung government into early lame duck status.” (김민석 전 총리가 연일 종교 단체 신천지의 민주당 전당대회 개입 의혹을 제기하고 있습니다. 특정 후보를 당선시키기 위해 신천지가 암약하고 있다는 것입니다. 이를 막기 위해 신천지 유령 당원을 청산해야 한다고도 했습니다. 친명 일각에서도 “신천지가 이재명 정부를 조기 레임덕에 빠트리기 위해 정청래 전 대표를 밀고 있다”고 주장합니다.)

However, former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae fired back, saying, “Provide the exact evidence,” and “If you mention my name, I will retaliate strongly.” He argues that former Prime Minister Kim and the pro-Myung faction are waging ‘hearsay’-style political attacks without presenting specific evidence. Shincheonji claims, “We have no interest in the Democratic Party’s national convention and have not interfered in any way.” The pro-Myung and pro-Cheong camps, locked in a fierce battle over the next party leadership, are engaged in a sharp war of words over the Shincheonji interference allegations. <<> Within the ruling bloc, there is considerable controversy over why former Prime Minister Kim keeps raising Shincheonji suspicions and whether Shincheonji is actually connected to former Representative Jeong. There is currently no direct evidence of collusion between Shincheonji and former Representative Jeong. <<> However, some within the pro-Myung faction claim that former Representative Jeong has attended events involving Shincheonji followers or met with related individuals. There are also rumors that Shincheonji is trying to recruit its followers as party members to interfere in the ruling bloc’s primary. There is significant suspicion that former Representative Jeong might be acting as a host within the party for Shincheonji. <<> There are several reasons for this. First is former Representative Jeong’s unwavering approval rating. Despite defeats in key battlegrounds in the June 3 election, discord with President Lee Jae-myung, and continuous attacks from the pro-Myung faction, his approval rating hasn’t dropped significantly. From the pro-Myung perspective, this is hard to achieve without a collective, unconditional support group like Shincheonji. <<> In this regard, claims have resurfaced that during the 2021 presidential primary, candidate Lee Nak-yon won big in the final Seoul primary, and the force behind it was Shincheonji. The question is whether the Shincheonji group that secretly maneuvered back then has now attached itself to former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae. <<> The past conflict between President Lee Jae-myung and Shincheonji during his time as Gyeonggi Governor over COVID-19 quarantine measures is also being brought up again. The suspicion is that Shincheonji, due to ill feelings toward President Lee and the pro-Myung faction, is deliberately entering the Democratic Party to engage in anti-Myung activities. President Lee himself emphasizes the principle of separation of church and state and strongly warns against religious groups interfering in party politics. However, there is no concrete evidence to support these suspicions. <<> The pro-Cheong camp counters, saying, “The pro-Myung faction’s Shincheonji offensive is a poison prescription to break former Representative Jeong’s stubborn support base.” They claim that while the Presidential Office and the pro-Myung faction have tried various ways to block former Representative Jeong’s re-election as party leader, their efforts have failed, leading them to resort to a negative campaign using religion. <<> A pro-Cheong lawmaker said, “Isn’t former Prime Minister Kim’s side making absurd claims about Shincheonji suspicions because they are anxious about the unfavorable trend in the primary?” adding, “If they continue with groundless, forced attacks, it will backfire.” <<> There is also an interpretation that the pro-Myung faction’s Shincheonji offensive is a card to check author Yoo Si-min. Yoo has recently been criticizing President Lee, following his ‘Lee Jae-myung government failure theory’ with remarks like ‘the stench of a rotten fish market.’ It is rare for such criticism to come from within the ruling bloc against a president who has been in office for just over a year. Many see the Shincheonji suspicions as a countermeasure to block Yoo’s unfettered criticism of the president. <<> It remains uncertain whether former Prime Minister Kim’s Shincheonji offensive will succeed. The key is whether there is convincing evidence or concrete proof. It is rare for a leading candidate or a mainstream candidate to initiate negative campaigning first. Former Prime Minister Kim has said, “I will disclose the evidence soon.” If he presents concrete evidence, former Representative Jeong could face significant damage. However, if he fails to provide evidence, it could fizzle out as a storm in a teacup or even backfire, leading to a counterattack from former Representative Jeong’s side. <<> The positions of the pro-Myung and pro-Cheong camps on the Shincheonji suspicions are completely opposite. Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok has been raising suspicions daily that Shincheonji is interfering in the primary to get a specific candidate elected. He has said, “Shincheonji is secretly maneuvering,” “We must eliminate Shincheonji ghost party members,” “This convention is a disguised battle against anti-Myung, factionalism, and Shincheonji,” and “We must break that triple alliance.” <<> Some within the pro-Myung faction argue, “Shincheonji, which tends to support the People Power Party, is pushing former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae to plunge the Lee Jae-myung government into early lame duck status and defeat former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok.” But former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae dismisses this as “absurd fake news.” He rebutted, saying, “This has nothing to do with me,” and “If they try to create a false image with fake news, I will take legal action with a zero-tolerance principle.” <<> This is not the first time the Shincheonji controversy has arisen. It traces back to the 2021 Democratic Party presidential primary. At that time, candidate Lee Nak-yon, who was trailing candidate Lee Jae-myung by a double score, won the final Seoul primary by a large margin. This was a period when voter sentiment was fluctuating wildly due to allegations of corruption in the Daejang-dong scandal involving candidate Lee. <<> At the time, the pro-Myung faction claimed, “There are suspicions that Shincheonji interfered in the primary to push candidate Lee Nak-yon.” YouTuber Kim Eo-joon claimed that “100,000 Shincheonji followers were systematically involved.” Both sides even ended up in legal battles over this. <<> The Shincheonji controversy also resurfaced during the Unification Church lobbying suspicions. The leader of Shincheonji was arrested on charges of attempting to interfere in the presidential and general election primaries by recruiting about 50,000 followers into the People Power Party. A special counsel investigation into the Unification Church and Shincheonji suspicions was also discussed at that time. However, the special counsel fell through, and the police took over the investigation. Regarding this, former Prime Minister Kim said, “We must go over each point about why a Shincheonji special counsel was not established.” But former Representative Jeong rebutted, saying, “The party, government, and presidential office had coordinated for the police to investigate.” <<> Suspicions were also raised that Democratic Party City Councilor Kim Kyung tried to register religious group followers as Democratic Party members. President Lee Jae-myung, at the end of last year, stated that “religious involvement in politics violates the constitutional principle of separation of church and state” and ordered a review of the dissolution of religious foundations. <<> The problem is whether there is concrete evidence for the Shincheonji interference claims. Former Prime Minister Kim has not presented specific evidence. He has only said, “I will speak at an appropriate time” and “I will disclose the evidence soon.” <<> The pro-Myung faction claims that the host of an event in the Honam region attended by former Representative Jeong was a Shincheonji follower. Along with rumors that former Representative Jeong met with Shincheonji figures, unverified videos are circulating. Some pro-Myung figures have said, “The Shincheonji side once approached us, offering to register 10,000 followers as party members.” However, as these are one-sided claims, they are hard to see as evidence of Shincheonji interference. Former Representative Song Young-gil said, “It seems strange people are entering the party,” but this also has not been verified. <<> Nevertheless, the Shincheonji suspicions continue to be raised due to the Democratic Party’s deep-seated suspicion and aversion to religious groups’ involvement in politics. President Lee also consistently emphasizes the separation of church and state. The concern is that the Unification Church and Shincheonji may have infiltrated not only the People Power Party but also the Democratic Party. <<> The pro-Myung faction’s greater fixation on the Shincheonji controversy stems from Jeong Cheong-rae’s stubborn approval rating. Regarding former Representative Jeong’s confrontations and discord with President Lee Jae-myung over various policy lines, such as the prosecution’s supplementary investigative powers, many ordinary citizens and ruling bloc supporters find it “hard to understand” and call it “unprecedented.” There have also been considerable calls for former Representative Jeong to take responsibility for the defeats in the June 3 election battlegrounds. The pro-Myung faction has consistently criticized him. <<> Yet, former Representative Jeong’s approval rating has not dropped significantly. While many polls among the broader ruling bloc show former Prime Minister Kim ahead, assessments among core party members suggest the gap between the two candidates is not large. The pro-Myung faction is perplexed by former Representative Jeong’s resilient approval rating. Regarding Jeong Cheong-rae’s support base, which bounces back no matter how hard it’s hit, pro-Myung figures say, “This is hard to understand” and “Isn’t there a problem with the party membership structure?” <<> Some suspect, “This is the result of Shincheonji using Jeong Cheong-rae as a host for their secret maneuvers.” They believe Shincheonji followers who joined the Democratic Party en masse are displaying an ‘unconditional anti-Myung’ and ‘strategic pro-Cheong’ movement. They attribute this to the past conflict with President Lee during the COVID-19 quarantine. However, there is no way to verify whether Shincheonji followers have actually joined the Democratic Party and are pushing for former Representative Jeong. Shincheonji denies this, stating, “We have no interest in the Democratic Party’s national convention and have never intervened.” <<> In response, the pro-Cheong camp argues, “The pro-Myung faction is spreading a Shincheonji conspiracy theory to tarnish Jeong Cheong-rae.” They see it as a deliberate strategy to brand ‘Jeong Cheong-rae = Shincheonji.’ They claim that former Prime Minister Kim and the pro-Myung side, unable to widen the approval rating gap and being chased by former Representative Jeong, are resorting to absurd and extreme negative tactics out of desperation. <<> Another interpretation is that this is a countermeasure against Yoo Si-min’s attacks on President Lee, such as calling him “bound to fail” and saying “a stench of a rotten fish market emanates.” It is seen as a ‘tooth for a tooth, eye for an eye’ retaliatory strategy. <<> How much will the Shincheonji war of words affect the Democratic Party primary? If, as the pro-Myung side claims, it is revealed that Shincheonji systematically registered followers as party members and was involved in the primary, it would have a huge impact on the primary landscape. Conversely, if the Shincheonji suspicions turn out to be false or involve only a few followers voluntarily joining, the impact will be minimal. However, without a police investigation, it is difficult to determine Shincheonji’s involvement before next month’s party convention. <<> More importantly, the credibility of the Shincheonji suspicions is crucial. If former Prime Minister Kim presents specific evidence or circumstances for the Shincheonji allegations, it could severely damage former Representative Jeong. But failing to provide evidence could backfire. It is said that the support ratings among party members for former Prime Minister Kim and former Representative Jeong are currently not far apart. The Shincheonji controversy is likely to influence the early primary race in some way. (하지만 정청래 전 대표는 “정확한 근거를 대라”며 “내 이름을 거론하면 강력 응징하겠다”고 맞받았습니다. 김 전 총리와 친명이 구체적 근거는 제시하지 않고 ‘카더라’식 정치 공세를 펴고 있다는 것입니다. 신천지 측은 “민주당 전당대회에 관심이 없고 어떠한 개입도 하지 않았다”고 주장했습니다. 차기 당권을 놓고 격돌하고 있는 명·청 진영이 신천지 개입설을 놓고 첨예한 공방전을 벌이는 것입니다.)

item.title: 'Real Estate Grand Debate' to be Held Once More… Chaired by Prime Minister on the 27th (‘부동산 대토론회’ 한 번 더 한다… 27일 韓총리가 진행)
item.description:
The government will hold another 'National Grand Debate on Real Estate Policy'. (정부가 ‘부동산 정책 국민 대토론회’를 한 번 더 연다.)

The Office of the Prime Minister announced on the afternoon of the 23rd that it will host the second grand debate, chaired by Prime Minister Han Seong-suk, at the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry in Jung-gu, Seoul, on the 27th. This announcement came about three hours after the first debate, chaired by President Jae-myung Lee, concluded. (국무총리실은 오는 27일 서울 중구 대한상공회의소에서 한성숙 국무총리 주재로 2차 대토론회를 주최한다고 23일 오후 밝혔다. 이재명 대통령 주재 대토론회가 종료된 지 약 3시간 만의 발표다.)

The Prime Minister's Office explained that the second debate was not pre-planned by the government and was hastily prepared based on the judgment that the day's debate was insufficient for gathering public opinion and discussing key issues. President Lee previously stated during the first debate, "If today's discussion falls short, I hope the Prime Minister can hold another round of talks in the meantime." (2차 대토론회는 정부가 사전에 계획하지 않은 것으로, 이날 대토론회가 국민 여론을 수렴하고 쟁점을 논의하기에 충분하지 않았다는 판단에 따라 급히 준비하게 된 것이라고 총리실은 설명했다. 이 대통령은 1차 대토론회에서 “오늘 이야기하다가 부족하면 총리께서 그 사이에 한 번 더 이야기를 해봤으면 좋겠다”고 말한 바 있다.)

The Prime Minister's Office decided to hold the second debate with the same topics and format as the first. It will involve listening to expert presentations on housing supply, finance, and taxation, followed by free discussion. The entire debate will be broadcast via KTV. Unlike the first event, Prime Minister Han will preside, as President Lee embarks on a foreign tour to the United States and other countries starting on the 24th. (총리실은 2차 대토론회를 1차 때와 같은 주제와 형식으로 진행하기로 했다. 주택 공급과 금융, 세제 분야에 관해 전문가 발표를 들은 뒤 자유 토론을 한다. 전체 토론은 KTV를 통해 중계된다. 24일 미국 등 순방에 나서는 이 대통령 대신 한 총리가 진행한다는 점이 1차 때와 다르다.)

The Prime Minister's Office stated that it will seek ways to ensure that the voices of young people are more prominently heard in the second debate. (총리실은 2차 대토론회는 청년의 목소리가 더 많이 나올 수 있는 방법을 모색하겠다고 했다.)
