item.title: "Many Problems with Yoon Administration's ODA Projects" — Budget Cut Then Increased Again… Next Year 6.3084 Trillion Won (“尹 정부 ODA 사업 문제 많다” 줄였던 예산 다시 늘린다… 내년 6조3084억원)
item.description:
The government, which had criticized issues with the previous administration's projects while cutting over 1 trillion won from this year's Official Development Assistance (ODA) budget, has decided to increase it by approximately 800 billion won next year. (정부가 이전 정부의 문제를 지적하면서 올해 1조원 넘게 삭감한 공적개발원조(ODA) 예산을 내년에 도로 8000억원가량 늘리기로 했다.)

On the afternoon of the 23rd, the government held the 58th International Development Cooperation Committee meeting at the Government Seoul Complex, chaired by Prime Minister Han Seong-suk, and announced the approval of the "Comprehensive International Development Cooperation Implementation Plan," which increases the ODA budget from 5.4372 trillion won this year to 6.3084 trillion won next year, a rise of 871.2 billion won. The project plan approved that day will be included in next year's budget proposal submitted by the government to the National Assembly, after undergoing budget review by the Ministry of Economy and Finance and a Cabinet meeting. During this process, some project budgets may be reduced or adjusted. (정부는 23일 오후 정부서울청사에서 한성숙 국무총리 주재로 제58차 국제개발협력위원회를 열어, 올해 5조4372억원인 ODA 예산을 내년에 6조3084억원으로 8712억원 늘리는 내용의 ‘국제 개발 협력 종합 시행 계획’을 의결했다고 밝혔다. 이날 의결된 사업 계획은 기획예산처의 예산 심사와 국무회의를 거쳐 정부가 국회에 제출하는 내년도 예산안에 들어간다. 이 과정에서 일부 사업 예산이 감액 등 조정될 수 있다.)

The government's ODA budget stood at 3.701 trillion won in the 2022 budget compiled just before the launch of the Yoon Seok-youl administration, but increased to 4.7771 trillion won in 2023, 6.2629 trillion won in 2024, and 6.501 trillion won last year. The Lee Jae-myung administration and the Democratic Party of Korea, citing "various issues" with the Yoon administration's ODA budget, reduced this year's budget to 5.4372 trillion won, a cut of 1.0638 trillion won. The plan is to restore it to a level close to that before the reduction. (정부의 ODA 예산은 윤석열 정부 출범 직전 편성된 2022년 예산에서는 3조7010억원이었으나 2023년 4조7771억원, 2024년 6조2629억원, 지난해 6조5010억원으로 늘었다. 이재명 정부와 더불어민주당은 윤석열 정부의 ODA 예산에 “여러 문제”가 있다며 올해 예산 규모를 5조4372억원으로 1조638억원 줄였다. 이를 다시 삭감 이전에 가까운 수준으로 되돌린다는 것이다.)

The trend of canceling many ODA projects initiated during the Yoon Seok-youl administration will be maintained. After reducing the number of projects from 1,928 last year to 1,763 this year (a decrease of 165), the plan is to further cut it to 1,227 projects next year, reducing by an additional 536. However, the amount allocated per project will be increased, so the overall budget scale will be larger than this year's. (윤석열 정부 시절 시작된 ODA 사업 다수를 취소시키는 기조는 유지된다. 지난해 추진하던 사업 1928개를 올해 1763개로 165개 줄인 데 이어, 내년에는 1227개 사업으로 536개 더 줄이기로 했다. 다만 사업당 투입하는 금액을 늘려, 전체 예산 규모가 올해보다 커지게 된다.)

The government plans to focus investments on projects that reduce drought and flood damage in partner countries, such as dam construction and river maintenance. Additionally, to enhance disaster risk response capabilities in partner countries, it will provide disaster safety policies and technologies, and also support socially vulnerable groups in partner countries, including children and the impoverished. The government sees culture and artificial intelligence (AI) as areas where Korea has strengths and has decided to pursue related projects as well. (정부는 댐 건설과 하천 정비 등 협력국의 가뭄과 홍수 피해를 줄이는 사업에 집중적으로 투입하기로 했다. 이와 함께 협력국의 재해 위험 대응 역량을 높이기 위해 재난 안전 정책과 기술을 제공하고, 아동과 빈곤층 등 협력국의 사회 취약 계층에 대한 지원도 추진한다. 정부는 문화·인공지능(AI) 분야가 한국이 강점을 가진 분야라고 보고, 이와 관련한 사업도 추진하기로 했다.)

The government also plans to concentrate ODA projects on countries it has designated as key partner countries. Although the government previously selected the 4th batch of key partner countries to be applied from this year through 2030, which countries are included has not been disclosed due to diplomatic relations with other nations. (정부는 또 ODA 사업을 정부가 중점 협력국으로 선정한 국가에 집중하기로 했다. 정부는 앞서 올해부터 2030년까지 적용되는 제4기 중점 협력국을 선정했으나, 어느 국가가 여기에 속하는지는 다른 국가들과의 외교 관계를 고려해 비공개했다.)

While presiding over the meeting, Prime Minister Han stated, "The international community is currently facing complex challenges such as climate crises, intensifying conflicts, growing humanitarian aid needs, and supply chain restructuring," adding, "In these changes, international development cooperation is a key policy for building a common future. It is time for us to more responsibly contribute to the sustainable growth and shared prosperity of partner countries using our development experience and innovative capabilities." (한 총리는 이날 회의를 주재하면서 “지금 국제사회는 기후 위기와 분쟁 심화, 인도적 지원 수요 증가, 공급망 재편 등 복합적인 도전에 직면해 있다”며 “이런 변화 속에서 국제 개발 협력은 공동의 미래를 만들어 가는 핵심 정책으로, 우리가 갖고 있는 발전의 경험과 혁신 역량으로 협력국의 지속 가능한 성장과 공동 번영에 더욱 책임 있게 기여해야 할 시점”이라고 했다.)

Prime Minister Han said, "We plan to further expand the proportion of ODA projects in the health, culture, and AI sectors," and "Through grant and loan aid package projects, infrastructure projects embedded with AI and culture, and revitalizing development finance, we will discover large-scale projects and enhance both their symbolic significance and effectiveness." (한 총리는 “보건, 문화, AI 분야 ODA 사업 비중을 보다 확대해갈 생각”이라며 “유·무상 원조 패키지 사업과 AI와 문화가 내재돼 있는 인프라 사업, 개발 금융 활성화 등을 통해 대규모 사업을 발굴하고 사업의 상징성과 효과성도 높여 가겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: 'Allegations of Shincheonji's Involvement in National Convention' Spread... Song Young-gil Says "They Approached Me Too", Chung Cheong-rae Demands "Reveal the Evidence" (‘신천지 전대 개입설’ 확산...송영길 “내게도 접근”, 정청래 “근거 밝혀라”)
item.description:
Amid the upcoming August 17th national convention of the Democratic Party of Korea, controversy is escalating over allegations raised by former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok regarding Shincheonji’s involvement in the party’s internal election. Pro-Lee Jae-myung figures claimed that, given suspicions that Shincheonji had systematically encouraged membership in major political parties in the past, the possibility of its interference in the Democratic Party convention should also be investigated. In contrast, former party leader Chung Cheong-rae, a candidate for party leader, and those aligned with him strongly pushed back, demanding that specific evidence be disclosed. <<> Within the Democratic Party, the past conflict between President Yoon Suk Yeol and Shincheonji leader Lee Man-hee is being cited as a backdrop to these suspicions. In 2020, during the COVID-19 pandemic, President Yoon, then Governor of Gyeonggi Province, forcibly shut down Shincheonji facilities and entered the 'Palace of Peace' in Gapyeong County. <<> The joint police-prosecution investigation team probing allegations of collusion between Shincheonji and political circles recently detained Lee Man-hee. During the investigation, it was alleged that in 2021, Lee instructed key followers to join the People Power Party, saying, "Because of Lee Jae-myung, we can't hold meetings or worship services. Yoon Suk Yeol must become president." The joint investigation team reportedly found that approximately 56,000 Shincheonji followers joined the People Power Party as a result. <<> Based on this, pro-Lee factions are suggesting the possibility that Shincheonji followers also systematically joined the Democratic Party. <<> Former Democratic Party leader Song Young-gil also claimed that Shincheonji approached him while he was leading the Pine Tree Party. Song stated on a YouTube broadcast that a Shincheonji representative proposed, "If Chairman Song, after his release from prison, meets Chairman Lee Man-hee just once, we will have a large number of followers join your party, resolve the party's debts, and support party membership fees." <<> Pro-Lee Supreme Council candidate Park Sun-won also held a press conference at the National Assembly on the 23rd, claiming that Shincheonji referred to the Democratic Party and the People Power Party as the 'Blue Party' and 'Red Party', or 'Blue Ribbon' and 'Red Ribbon', and encouraged followers to hold dual memberships. <<> Representative Park stated, "At certain times, they issued directives like 'Wear a red ribbon' or 'Wear a blue ribbon'," and added, "During what they called the 'Pilates Project'—a membership drive—they set membership targets by district and department and instructed followers on which candidate to vote for." <<> He further claimed, "They required submission of vote completion screenshots or participant lists, and reportedly reprimanded organizations that fell short of the target." However, the details disclosed by Representative Park that day did not confirm whether Shincheonji had actually interfered in the current Democratic Party convention. <<> Representative Park said, "Since allegations have been raised, this cannot end as mere bickering or negative campaigning among candidates," and announced that if elected to the Supreme Council, he would form an independent fact-finding body involving external legal experts and professionals. He stated that the body would examine whether there was a sudden surge in new party members at specific times and the patterns of membership, to determine if there was any organized effort to help a particular candidate get elected. <<> Pro-Lee Supreme Council candidate Lee Gun-tae also announced on Facebook the establishment and operation of a "Reporting Center for Allegations of Shincheonji's Organized Membership Enrollment in the National Convention." <<> Former leader Chung Cheong-rae and his aligned faction pushed back, calling it baseless allegations. On Facebook, Chung said, "I will respond with the strongest measures to these enormous allegations that could plunge the Democratic Party into the danger of being an unconstitutional party," and added, "If the evidence cannot be produced, one must also consider making a decision about their own position." <<> Regarding former Prime Minister Kim's mention that a special counsel investigation into Shincheonji fell through during the Chung Cheong-rae leadership, Chung explained, "In the coordination process between the party, government, and presidential office, it was judged that due to a shortage of dispatched prosecutors, we didn't have the capacity to handle a special counsel probe for both Shincheonji and the Unification Church. So, it was decided to first entrust it to the police investigation and later combine it with a special counsel for the manipulation prosecution case." <<> Explanations also emerged that previous party-level investigations had not confirmed any organized enrollment of members from specific religious groups like Shincheonji. Rep. Cho Seung-rae, who oversaw the party secretariat's related investigation ahead of local elections, stated, "We cross-referenced the addresses of national offices, churches, and other meeting places of religious groups with addresses in the party membership list, but could not confirm any substance." <<> Representative Cho added, "However, there is a limitation in that cases where members joined using personal addresses like residences or workplaces cannot be verified." <<> (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 김민석 전 국무총리가 제기한 신천지의 당내 선거 개입 의혹을 둘러싼 논란이 확산하고 있다. 친명계 인사들은 신천지가 과거 주요 정당의 당원 가입을 조직적으로 독려했다는 의혹을 들어 민주당 전당대회 개입 가능성도 조사해야 한다고 주장했다. 반면 당 대표 후보인 정청래 전 대표와 친정청래계 인사들은 구체적인 근거를 공개하라며 강하게 반발했다.)

item.title: Yoo Ui-dong Elected as PPP’s Land Committee Chair by 1 Vote... Opposition’s 7 Standing Committee Chair Candidates Confirmed (국힘 국토위원장 경선서 유의동 1표차로 선출…야당 몫 7개 상임위원장 후보 확정)
item.description:
Yoo Ui-dong Elected as PPP’s Land Committee Chair by 1 Vote... Opposition’s 7 Standing Committee Chair Candidates Confirmed (국힘 국토위원장 경선서 유의동 1표차로 선출…야당 몫 7개 상임위원장 후보 확정)

In the People Power Party’s internal primary to select the candidate for the National Assembly’s Land, Infrastructure and Transport Committee chair, Rep. Yoo Ui-dong, a four-term lawmaker from a non-mainstream faction, edged out Rep. Kim Jeong-jae, a three-term lawmaker from the mainstream faction, by a single vote to secure the nomination. (국회 국토교통위원장 후보를 선출하기 위한 국민의힘 당내 경선에서 비주류에 속하는 4선의 유의동 의원이 구주류 3선 김정재 의원을 1표차로 앞서 국토위원장 후보로 확정됐다.)

The PPP held a general meeting of lawmakers at the National Assembly on the 23rd and confirmed candidates for the seven standing committee chairs allocated to the opposition party. In the primary for the Land Committee chair, where Yoo and Kim faced off, Yoo received 49 votes, while Kim garnered 48 votes. (국민의힘은 23일 오전 국회에서 의원총회를 열고 야당 몫 7개 상임위원장 후보를 확정했다. 국토위원장 후보로 유 의원과 김 의원이 나서 경선을 실시한 결과, 유 의원이 49표를 얻고 김 의원이 48표를 얻었다.)

Typically, standing committee chairs have been held by three-term lawmakers. Accordingly, the leadership and three-term lawmakers had agreed that Rep. Kim and fellow three-term Rep. Song Seok-jun would alternately serve as chairs of the Land, Infrastructure and Transport Committee and the Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee, respectively, for one year each. However, Yoo registered as a candidate, leading to a primary. Rep. Ahn Cheol-soo, a four-term lawmaker, initially considered running for the Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee chair but ultimately did not register as a candidate. (통상 상임위원장은 3선 의원이 맡아왔다. 이에 원내 지도부와 3선 의원들은 김 의원과 같은 3선의 송석준 의원이 국토위원장과 외교통일위원장을 각각 1년씩 교대로 맡는 것으로 합의했었다. 그러나 유 의원이 후보로 등록하며 경선으로 이어졌다. 4선의 안철수 의원도 당초 외교통일위원장 입후보를 고심했지만, 최종 후보 등록은 하지 않았다.)

For the other six standing committee chairs, lawmakers who ran unopposed were confirmed as candidates: Rep. Kim Hee-jung (Education Committee), Rep. Song Seok-jun (Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee), Rep. Kim Seong-won (Trade, Industry, Energy, SMEs and Startups Committee), Rep. Lee Man-hee (Health and Welfare Committee), Rep. Lee Yang-soo (Intelligence Committee), and Rep. Lim Lee-ja (Gender Equality and Family Committee). (다른 6개 상임위원장의 경우 단독 입후보한 김희정(교육위원장)·송석준(외교통일위원장)·김성원(산업통상자원중소벤처기업위원장)·이만희(보건복지위원장)·이양수(정보위원장)·임이자(성평등가족위원장) 의원이 후보로 추인됐다.)

The ruling and opposition parties are set to elect the chairs of the seven standing committees during a plenary session at the National Assembly this afternoon. Earlier, on the 30th of last month, ten standing committees, including the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and the Special Committee on Budget and Accounts had their chairs elected under the leadership of the ruling party. Once the opposition’s standing committee chairs are confirmed today, the formation of the second half of the 22nd National Assembly will be completed. (여야는 이날 오후 국회 본회의에서 7개 상임위의 위원장을 선출하게 된다. 앞서 지난달 30일 여권 주도로 법제사법위원회 등 10개 상임위와 예산결산특별위원회 위원장을 선출했다. 이날 야당 몫 상임위원장이 확정되면 22대 국회 후반기 원 구성이 마무리된다.)

item.title: Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik Holds All-Staff Meeting at the Presidential Office... "United Blue House is the Goal" (강훈식, 靑 전직원 대상 조회 개최... “유나이티드 청와대가 목표”)
item.description:
Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik held an all-staff meeting at the Blue House on the 23rd. It appears to be aimed at announcing the goals and operational direction for the second year of the administration, while also urging discipline among public officials ahead of President Lee's schedule for a tour of South America. (강훈식 대통령 비서실장은 23일 청와대에서 전 직원 대상 조회를 개최했다. 청와대 2년차 목표와 운영 방향을 알리는 한편, 이 대통령의 남미 순방 일정을 앞두고 공직 기강을 당부하는 차원으로 보인다.)

Regarding the government's achievements over the past year, Chief Kang stated at the meeting that they involved "not visible indicators like the KOSPI or export figures, but rather properly correcting abnormal practices and establishing a system where performance matches effort." The Blue House announced through a press release that he expressed gratitude and respect to employees who demonstrated the spirit of a 'One Team Blue House' for these accomplishments. (강 실장은 이날 조회에서 지난 1년 간 정부 성과에 대해 “코스피, 수출액 등 눈에 보이는 지표가 아닌 비정상적인 것을 제대로 바로잡은 것, 일한 만큼 성과를 낼 수 있는 시스템을 구축한 것 등”이라며 이를 위해 ‘원팀 청와대’의 모습을 보여 준 직원들에게 감사와 존경의 뜻을 전달했다고 청와대는 보도자료를 통해 밝혔다.)

He then urged everyone to "maximize individual and departmental capabilities while creating greater achievements as a single organization," and proposed the term 'United Blue House' as the goal for the second year, reflecting this meaning. (이어 “각자 그리고 각 부서의 역량을 최대치로 발휘하면서도 하나의 조직으로서 더 큰 성과를 만들어 가자”고 주문하면서, 이러한 의미를 담고 있는 용어로 ‘유나이티드(United) 청와대’를 2년차 목표로 제시했다.)

Chief Kang emphasized the need to "become a Blue House that interprets, plans, and operates flexibly," adding that this requires understanding public sentiment and global trends, as well as the flexibility to operate like a 'connected team.' (강 실장은 “해석하고, 기획하고, 유연하게 임하는 청와대가 되자”며 이를 위해 민심과 세상의 흐름을 읽을 줄 알아야 하고, ’하나로 연결된 팀‘처럼 움직이는 유연함이 필요하다고 강조했다.)

Meanwhile, the Blue House reported that Chief Kang reflected on the first year as "a period where we not only made plans but also executed and delivered tangible results, almost like treating it as a 'single term,'" and reaffirmed his determination to approach the second year "with the resolve that it is the first year of a second term." (한편, 강 실장은 “청와대는 지난 1년간 계획만 세운 게 아니라 실행도 하고 체감있는 성과까지 내야했던 해로서 마치 ’하나의 임기‘처럼 보냈다”며 집권 2년차를 “두 번째 임기의 첫 해라는 각오로 보내려고 한다”며 의지를 다졌다고 청와대는 전했다.)
